notes.title: Hotfix: Inferno-3.0-1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/0cb0dca02b1eb5e98266f17386d0b85cdbcd5f98.png[/img]

Hiló Vikings!🛠️  We have deployed a Hotfix to resolve issues identified during Season 3, including various crashes and Xbox invite issues.

There's [b]no downtime[/b] - you'll just have to restart Tribes of Midgard to see the changes! 🙌

[h2]Game Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Higher-powered Enemies now also drop the basic Materials of their lower-powered counterparts, in addition to their usual higher-tier Materials. 
[list]
[*] [i]For example, weaker Unsunken Warriors drop Yarn, while the strongest Unsunken Warriors drop Spun Yarn. Now, the strongest Unsunken Warriors will also drop Yarn in addition to Spun Yarn. Journal entries for these enemies were updated to reflect their full loot possibilities.[/i]
[/list]
[/list][h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Xbox, PlayStation] Fixed a crash that could occur when exiting a World just as the Console is going into a suspend state 
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when specific inputs were pressed during game loading
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur during the fishing sequence
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when harvesting Resource nodes with the Spear equipped
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when completing the Rune Scribe Challenge
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when respawning from the Hunter’s Totem
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Embers Armor Set did not have accurate Temperature  protection values. It now correctly has a much higher protection against Heat
[*] Fixed a number of issues that could happen as a result of idling or restoring a lost connection in the Tutorial
[*] Fixed an issue in which VFX from the Surtr’s Spire Spear could linger during certain animations
[*] Fixed instances in which players would not receive an error message when trying to accept an old game invitation from a transitional or loading screen
[*] Fixed some legibility issues with player names on the Minimap in the Village
[*] Fixed an issue in which the footstep SFX could be missing while holding a Spear
[*] Fixed an issue that could happen in the Shop in which the Purchase option for a Cosmetic would not update quickly enough after getting more Platinum Coins
[*] [Xbox] Fixed an issue in which Survival Sessions were not listed as Joinable from the Friend’s List
[*] [Xbox] Fixed an issue in which players were unable to send Invites from Private Survival Worlds
[*] [Xbox Series X]Fixed an issue with the rooftop transparency effect in the Village Longhouse
[*] [Xbox Series X] Fixed an issue in which some environment assets were set to the wrong quality setting
[/list]
As mentioned in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3371528779279483728]yesterday's blog post[/url], we're looking to also increase the Construction limit. We’re also looking into Construction height, pulling Materials directly from Storage Chests, and alerts to prevent dismantling a Storage Chest that contains Items, among a few.

Talk again soon!

notes.title: Season 3 Post Launch: Top FAQ, Known Issues, Construction Limit - Dev Blog #4
notes.notes:
Hiló Vikings,

It’s been just about [b]two weeks since the launch of Season 3[/b], and since Tribes of Midgard newly arrived to players on Xbox and Nintendo Switch! In case you’re new here (hello, welcome!!) or need a quick reminder, here’s just some of what rolled in with the Inferno Saga update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/7d2b3206944b96e45312139529b4b8f91a704c29.png[/img]

We wanted to take today to talk about your feedback, upcoming improvements, and celebrate what we’ve seen you create so far! Let’s get into it.

[h2]Survival Mode Changes & Construction System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c60ffc185e9602bff7e39fe5d2c4246d5dba306b.jpg[/img]

First and foremost, we have seen that you have been reaching the limit for Constructions. We completely understand the desire to build bigger, better, and more creative Viking settlements, and it’s one of our top priorities to increase this limitation.

In all transparency, the cap was set in place due to technical limitations, and we’re working on revamping that system to see what’s viable, while ensuring the game remains as stable as possible. We expect the increase in Constructions [b]to take effect in game early October[/b], aligning with our Valhalloween update. 

We’ll stay in close touch and let you know as soon as this change can be made - thank you so much for your understanding and patience. It’s not just the Construction limit that we're looking into - we’re also looking into Construction height, pulling Materials directly from Storage Chests, and alerts to prevent dismantling a Storage Chest that contains Items, among a few.

[h2]Top FAQ[/h2]

We also wanted to recap some of the top-asked questions this past week or so:
[list]
[*] [b]Where can Yarn be found?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yarn can be found on Unsunken Enemies at Ash Beach (Survival + Saga), or, it can be crafted through the Tanning Station (Survival) or Tinker (Saga).
[/list]
[*] [b]Do Ancients respawn in Survival Mode?[/b]
[list]
[*] No, Ancients do not respawn in Survival Mode (however, we’re always open to feedback and this may change in the future). Jötnar respawn and they will level up. 
[/list]
[*] [b]Where can I find Quest Fragments in Survival Mode?[/b]
[list]
[*] You must craft the Artifact Altar. First, you’ll craft the Mining Cutter from the Allforge. Then from the Mining Cutter, you can craft the Artifact Altar, so long as you have a strand of Angrboða’s hair.
[*] We are also exploring bringing Quest NPCs to Survival Mode in Season 4.
[/list]
[*] [b]How can I Repair items in Survival Mode?[/b]
[list]
[*] You repair for Souls using the Allforge (deployable anytime from the Build Menu).
[/list]
[/list]If you ever have more game questions, don’t hesitate to pop by our Discord.

[h2]Reporting Issues and Upcoming Hotfix[/h2]

If you’re experiencing any bugs or issues, similarly please be sure to either [url=https://discord.gg/tribesofmidgard]head to our Discord[/url] or [url=https://forums.tribesofmidgard.com/index.php]Forums[/url] to receive real-time assistance. You can find the full list of currently [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858820/discussions/1/3183485686830191859/]known issues here.[/url]

There will be an upcoming hotfix to address some known issues, particularly surrounding game stability, including:
[list]
[*] Higher powered enemies will now also drop the basic Materials of their lower-powered counterparts, in addition to Refined Materials. 
[list]
[*] [i]For example, weaker Unsunken Warriors drop Yarn, while the strongest Unsunken Warriors drop Spun Yarn. Now, the strongest Unsunken Warriors will also drop Yarn in addition to Spun Yarn.[/i]
[/list][*] Multiple fixes relating to various crash issues [All platforms]
[*] Fixed an issue in which Survival Sessions were not listed as Joinable from the Friend’s List [Xbox]
[*] Fixed an issue in which players were unable to send Invites from Private Survival Worlds [Xbox]
[*] And more, to be shared very soon!
[/list]
[h2]Guides[/h2]

We've seen some great guides created by our community, and others have been created in our Forum, you can check those out here:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ROkimg-_6WU]Triple G’s Complete Guide to Survival[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PDGByLfHOUY]A Powerpoint Guide to Surtr[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WoMU5k-qUBE]Jade PG Guide to Summer and Winter in Survival Mode[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.tribesofmidgard.com/index.php?threads/10-tips-and-tricks-to-playing-tribes-of-midgard.1135/]10 Tips and Tricks to Playing Tribes of Midgard[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.tribesofmidgard.com/index.php?threads/the-sundial-world-clock-in-tribes-of-midgard-explained.1195/]The World Clock Explained[/url]
[/list]
[h2]Community Highlights[/h2]

Though we are working to address the Construction limit and other pain points, we’ve so far seen some pretty awesome builds submitted in our Discord. Here’s just a few of them we wanted to feature:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ebf79b1f2677160b35ef5f77d305f5af46a8195d.png[/img]
[i]So many cozy homes.[/i]

And lastly, how could we not share this impeccable Linnorm Costume?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/9b4fc25be9f47cb8315a3e28a9851532807b7d24.jpg[/img]
[i]Created by Discord member MattBarr[/i]

Be sure to join us on Discord or Twitter to hear all the latest news, and to chat with us directly! We’re still taking in plenty of feedback, and aiming to address some of your top concerns and suggestions. 

Thanks for the trust and patience - we hope you’re otherwise having a great time taking down Surtr!

Talk soon, and seil seil,
The Norsfell Team

notes.title: Season 3: Inferno Saga Patch Notes August 16, 2022
notes.notes:
[i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] Season 3 is LIVE!
[previewyoutube=UZJYHXL0W9k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3409807423270532623][i]Read the “New Features” Blog Post for even more detail![/i][/url]

[list][*][b]New Saga Quest: Inferno[/b]
[list][*]Added support for Saga Quest: Inferno to guide entry into the Volcanic Spire to face the biggest threat to Midgard yet, Surtr![/list]
[*][b]New Biome: Volcanic Spire[/b]
[list][*]Added support for the new volcanic Biome, including all new Creatures, Materials, Camps, and Hazards to discover.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/bfb5547b0f07f5c086d25a99bb79e7bfe9cf0a6a.jpg[/img]
[*][b]New Ancient: Surtr[/b]
[list][*]Surtr has launched an all-out invasion from his lair at the peak of the Volcanic Spire. Fight your way to him to prevent burning the world from his volcanic fire![/list]
[*][b]Revenge of the Ancients:[/b]
[list][*]Saga Bosses are now referred to by their Midgardian moniker of ‘Ancients’ in all relevant in-game messaging and text.[/list]
[*][b]New Weapon Type: Spear[/b]
[list][*]Added a new Weapon type, Spear! This has considerable linear reach compared to other Weapons.
[*]The starting Villager Spear is crafted with only Wood, perfect for fighting off enemies early!
[list][*][i]See the Crafting Section of the Patch Notes for a breakdown of the available Spears[/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]New Activity: Fishing[/b]
[list][*]Craft Fishing Rods to interact with Mysterious Ripples appearing in the water.
[*]Interacting with the Mysterious Ripples starts a time-sensitive mini-game for additional Materials used in new recipes.
[list][*][i]See the Content Section for types of Fishable loot, as well as the Crafting Section for what Recipes they can be used in[/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]Revamped Game Over Screens[/b]
[list]
[*]See more stats in three Game Over screens you can review or skip:
[list][*][b]Global Results:[/b] Includes World stats such as Map Information, Enemies Slain, and Time Elapsed.
[*][b]Team Results:[/b] Shows player information, including Character Levels and a top stat consisting of their highest score.
[*][b]Personal Results:[/b] The final showcase of all noteworthy statistics accrued during the session, as well as where Season XP is tallied.[/list][/list][/list]

[h2]Survival 2.0[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/9b0d482de641a8719717172c2c4f433391dd758c.png[/img]
[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3368148492288843855]Read the Survival 2.0 Blog Post for even more details![/url][/i]

[b]Survival Mode[/b] has been fully rebuilt from the ground up!  Our aim with this re-work is to transform Survival into a more relaxed but equally exciting [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] experience. You can read the individual details on the Survival 2.0 Blog Post.
[list][*][b]Core Gameplay:[/b]
[list][*]No longer locked behind Season Level 2.
[*]No Village = No Village to defend at night.
[*]Days will last longer at 20 minutes each.
[*]Helthings will spawn sporadically throughout the environment at night but will not attack the Seed of Yggdrasil.
[*]Jötnar have their own Arenas that you can choose to travel to and defeat whenever you want.[/list]
[*][b]Saga Quests in Survival:[/b]
[list][*]Saga Quests unlock powerful Crafting Stations that will allow you to sail to new lands, craft better loot, and take on greater challenges.[/list]
[*][b]Session-Based Blessing Tree and Level Progression:[/b]
[list][*]An entirely new Blessing Tree has been created for the game mode that allows for more freedom to pick and choose among 90 Blessings as you see fit.
[*]Increased the Max Character Level to 50.
[*]No Shared Character XP.[/list]
[*][b]Season/Meta Progression:[/b]
[list][*]Season XP has a chance to drop from activities.
[*]Defeating powerful enemies or raiding Camps guarantees large amounts of Season XP.
[*]Season XP is automatically attributed to your Account Profile and contributes to Season Progress.[/list]
[*][b]Large Worlds, tailored to Survival Mode: [/b]
[list][*]Players start on a large, central continent and will be able to explore the open seas as they progress through the Saga Quests.
[*]Added new ways to encourage exploration via Crafting at the Allforge
[list][*][b]Craft Beds:[/b] Beds can be claimed to serve as Respawn points.
[*][b]Craft Bonfires:[/b] Bonfires will help keep you warm in cold climates so long as you deposit Branches to keep the fires alive.
[*][b]Craft Shrines:[/b] Shrines act as Fast Travel points, allowing you and your Tribe to build your own travel network throughout Midgard![/list][/list]
[*][b]Players are equipped with the Allforge:[/b]
[list][*]All crafting in Survival 2.0 centers around the building of these specific Crafting Stations for whatever you might need.
[list][*]Crafting Stations can be upgraded to unlock more powerful recipes and even entirely new stations.
[*][i]See the Content Section below for a breakdown of all the new Construction pieces available as of the launch of Inferno Saga.[/i][/list][*]The Allforge is located in the Build Menu and can be placed anywhere, free of material costs.[list][*]Only one Allforge per person can be deployed at a time.[/list][*]The Allforge will repair Equipment for a standard Souls Cost.
[*]Crafting Stations, Constructions, and Decorations are all crafted from the Allforge.[/list]
[*][b]Updated Construction to be more modular and significantly more flexible:[/b]
[list][*]Constructions are scaled to fit a 1x1x1 area for increased interconnectivity.
[*]Walls, pillars, roofs, and doors have been added.
[*]Constructions are available in three tiers with different levels of strength and material requirements.
[*]The camera is able to be rotated while in the Build Menu.
[*]Constructions are able to be placed along the Z-Axis.
[*]The Mallet is now triggered by default in the Build Menu:
[list][*]Dismantle by highlighting the Construction you want to remove.
[*]Repair Constructs in the Build Menu.[/list][/list]
[*][b]Freyja’s chatty cats Sóleyra and Mániklo have arrived:[/b]
[list][*]They help new Einherjar as they interact with certain triggers in the environment for the first time.[/list]
[*][b]Mode selection improvements:[/b]
[list][*]Survival is now showcased on the Main Play tab alongside Saga Mode.
[*]The new Survival 2.0 game mode now comes with the option to play in a Solo session just like Saga Mode. 
[*]Players can now form Groups via Invite to Join or Create a Survival 2.0.[/list][/list]

[h2]Blessing Updates[/h2]
With [b]Inferno Saga[/b], every Class received [b]2[/b] brand new Blessings, with some receiving changes to an existing Blessing.

Blessings are a vital part of [i]Tribes of Midgard’s[/i] genre-blending [i]Surthrival[/i] gameplay, and we wanted to take the opportunity with Inferno Saga to re-evaluate how each of the Classes is performing and how the community has been utilizing their Blessings to create unique play styles. 

As mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3368148492288843855]Survival 2.0 Blog[/url] post, the class system has been taken out of Survival Mode in favor of a brand new Blessing Tree. Different skills will be unlockable as you increase your Character Level during gameplay. These additional skills and changes will be included in the Blessing Tree for Survival Mode as well.

To read more about the changes, read the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3409807423270286459]Blessing and Combat Updates Blog post[/url]. 

[list][*][b]Warrior[/b]
[list][*][b]Underdog[/b] [NEW]: Feeling surrounded? Great! Increase damage dealt per each nearby enemy. 
[*][b]Warrior-Gatherer[/b] [NEW]: Labor like the Warrior gods of old! Combo attacks from any Weapon can now break Resource nodes, retrieving their precious Materials without Tools. Everything’s an axe!
[*][b]Reckless Roll[/b] [UPDATED]: Now avoid damage throughout the entire Evade roll animation.[/list]
[*][b]Ranger[/b]
[list][*][b]Ullr’s Step II[/b] [NEW]: Ullr’s Step now triggers a rain of arrows on your original position, dealing [medium] physical damage over time.
[*][b]Ricochet[/b] [NEW]: Each arrow fired has a 50% chance to ricochet, bouncing to up to 3 additional enemies.
[*][b]Quickshot[/b] [UPDATED]: Was originally affecting Arrow flight speed and now affects the attack speed of Bow Combo Attacks.[/list]
[*][b]Guardian[/b]
[list][*][b]Pain Release II[/b] [NEW]: Let it all out! Gain increased attack and movement speed for 5 seconds after unleashing your Pain.
[*][b]Unwavering[/b] [NEW]: The judgment of Forseti is absolute. Stand your ground against any who would dare say otherwise by becoming immune to knockback effects.[/list]
[*][b]Seer[/b]
[list][*][b]Yggdrasil’s Roots II[/b] [NEW]: Enemies entering the Seedling’s radius receive damage from the roots of the World Tree. Wouldn’t want to be on its bad side.
[*][b]Sacred Revive[/b] [NEW]: Further empowered by the golden apples of youth, reviving allies now triggers a healing pool in the area, granting HP over time.
[*][b]Tempered[/b] [UPDATED]: Now generates an aura that reduces Temperature effects for you and nearby allies.[/list]
[*][b]Berserker[/b]
[list][*][b]Undying Anger[/b] [NEW]: Channel the rage of war. Automatically self-revive when down and receive healing based on your current Wrath.
[*][b]Wrath Soothed[/b] [UPDATED]: Gain HP for every enemy hit by your Blast.
[*][b]Battle Resistance II[/b] [UPDATED]: Chance to resist Stun/Slow effects increased from 75% to 100%.[/list]
[*][b]Hunter[/b]
[list][*][b]Skaði’s Spirit II[/b] [NEW]: Your Decoy is now armed with a Bow and will fire Arrows at nearby enemies.
[*][b]Skaði’s Wolf[/b] [NEW]: Roll to deploy Skaði’s kindred spirit that will attack nearby enemies. Go get ’em boy!
[*][b]Skaði’s Spirit I[/b] [UPDATED]: There is now a visual indicator to show the Decoy’s taunt radius.[/list]
[*][b]Sentinel[/b]
[list][*][b]Shield Throw II[/b] [NEW]: Your Shield Throw ability now throws the second shield in rapid succession.
[*][b]Shield Ring II[/b] [NEW]: Shield spin to win. Your Shield Ring ability will now revolve around you a second time, dealing damage and effects twice.[/list]
[*][b]Warden[/b]
[list][*][b]Secret Stash[/b] [NEW]: Vigilance is key when safeguarding a Village’s supplies, and their trade secrets! Materials carried are no longer lost upon defeat.
[*][b]Rationing[/b] [NEW]: An Einherjar knows how important rationing can be in dire times. Gain a 25% chance to recover a Meal immediately after use.
[*][b]Dwarven Made[/b] [UPDATED]: Now reduces Repair costs & Equipment Durability loss by 50%.[/list]
[*][b]Blessing Trees[/b]
[list][*]Most Classes have received an update to the layout of their Blessing Trees.
[*]With the advent of new and updated Blessings, this new layout should also make it easier to navigate each, with a better grouping of related Blessings.[/list][/list]

[h2]Combat Update[/h2]

[*][b]Changes to Invincibility Frames:[/b]
[list][*]Applied i-Frames when Evading to all Characters.
[list][*][i]The Warrior’s Reckless Roll Blessing has been updated[/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]Changes to Animation Cancelling:[/b]
[list][*]Added Animation Cancelling when Evading/Blocking.[/list]
[*][b]Changes to Mana Gains:[/b]
[list][*]Successfully blocking enemy attacks with a Shield will now reward additional Mana. 
[list][*]Guardians will synergize well with this change, as their [i]Refused Judgement[/i] Blessing will allow them to gain even more Mana per Shield block.[/list][*]You now earn a set amount of Mana per attack, regardless of how many enemies were struck in that attack.[/list]
[*][b]Changes to Durability Loss:[/b]
[list][*]Similar to Mana Gains, your Weapon will now only lose a set amount of durability per attack, regardless of how many enemies were struck.[/list]
[*][b]Mana Loss from Powerful Foes:[/b]
[list][*]Being struck by Powerful Foes will leave you winded, causing you to lose a bit of Mana from your gauge.
[list][*]Powerful Foes include Jötnar, Elites (red skull indicator), Ancients, and the roaming mini-bosses of Midgard (yellow health bar).[/list][/list]
[*][b]Combat Feel and Weapon Tuning:[/b]
[list][*]Slight increase to the camera shake and sense of weight from Attack SFX when landing a hit, adjusted per Weapon type.
[list][*]Added the option in Settings to adjust camera shaking on a scale.[/list][*]Animation timing has been adjusted for all Weapon types, to better hone-in on their combat identity and gameplay niches.[list]
[*]The Bow has received a more notable overhaul:
[*]Damage of standard combo attacks has been significantly increased.
[*]Damage and speed of Aimed / Charged Shots were reduced.
[*]Durability increased.[/list][/list]

[h2]Crafting[/h2]
[h3]Survival Crafting Update[/h3]
Crafting in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3368148492288843855]Survival Update[/url] is handled differently. To replace the handiwork of the Saga Mode Villagers is no easy task, but luckily Survival players will be able to replicate everything they do (and more!) with our trusty new [b]Crafting Stations[/b]. Simply enter Build Mode, then the Build Menu to get started by building your [b]Allforge[/b]. Crafting Stations can be upgraded to provide more recipes, but some may have special conditions before they can be built.

[list][*][b]Allforge:[/b] The central crafting station from which all others are born. Does not cost anything to put down, but you can only have one at a time. It can also repair your Equipment!
[*][b]Crafting Stations – Exclusively in Survival Mode:[/b]
[list][*][b]Bed:[/b] Place it to serve as your Respawn Point when claimed. 
[*][b]Tool Grinder:[/b] For crafting all Tools, including the new Fishing Rods.
[*][b]Meal Cauldron:[/b] For crafting the new Meal recipes.
[*][b]Potion Brewer:[/b] For crafting Potions. 
[list][*][i]Unlocked through Survival 2.0 Saga Quest progress.[/i][/list][*][b]Weapon Furnace:[/b] For crafting Weapons.
[*][b]Shield Rack:[/b] For crafting Shields.
[*][b]Armor Loom[/b]: For crafting Armor.
[*][b]Defense Workshop:[/b] For crafting Traps and Watchtowers.[list][*][i]Unlocked through Survival 2.0 Saga Quest progress.[/i][/list][*][b]Ammunition Shelf:[/b] For crafting specialized Arrows.
[*][b]Boat Dock:[/b] For crafting Boats.[list][*][i]Unlocked through Survival 2.0 Saga Quest progress.[/i][/list][*][b]Lumbering Stand:[/b] For crafting Wood-based Ingredients.
[*][b]Tanning Stand:[/b] For crafting Leather, Fur, and Yarn Ingredients.
[*][b]Mining Stand:[/b] For crafting Stone, Ore, and Iron Ingredients.
[*][b]Artifact Altar:[/b] For crafting Artifacts.
[list][*][i]Unlocked through Survival 2.0 Saga Quest progress.[/i][/list][*][b]Construction Bench / Rig / Table:[/b] For crafting Constructions, like Walls, Stairs, Roofs, etc. 
[*][b]Portal Shrine:[/b] For fast-travel between other Shrines.
[*][b]Bonfire:[/b] Provides warmth. Must deposit kindling with Branches to activate and increase the duration
[*][b]Storage Box / Trunk / Chest:[/b] A deployable Storage container to deposit and share resources with your Tribe (or for your own safekeeping). Inventory space is upgraded by building higher rarity Storage Boxes from improved Constructions Stations.
[/list]
[*][b]New Construction Pieces:[/b]
[list][*]The Survival Update comes equipped with a plethora of new and adjusted Construction pieces. 
[*]Construction pieces in Survival Mode have been globally scaled down to 1×1 or 1x1x1 in terms of grid size, to increase interconnectivity and customization options.
[*]Each Construction type comes in three tiers; ranging from twig/thatch and wood to slate/stone.
[list][*][b]Ground[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Wall[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Wall Slope[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Pillar[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Beam[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Angle Beam[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Stairs[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Roof[/b] – Thatch/Wooden/Slate
[*][b]Flat Roof[/b] – Thatch/Wooden/Slate
[*][b]Roof Cross[/b] – Thatch/Wooden/Slate
[*][b]Fence[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Barrier[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Door[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Double Door[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Frame[/b] – Thatch/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Angle Frame[/b] – Thatch/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Dragon Ornament[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[*][b]Watchtower[/b] – Twig/Wooden/Stone
[list][*][i]Includes an Archer to fight off nearby enemies. Can deposit more powerful Arrows to increase effectiveness.[/i][/list][*][b]Eir Effigy of Life:[/b]
[list][*]Activate to Heal over time[/list][*][b]Eir Effigy of Haste:[/b]
[list][*]Activate to receive a Speed boost for a time[/list][*][b]Eir Effigy of Mana:[/b]
[list][*]Activate to regenerate Mana over time[/list][/list][/list]
[*][b]Decorative Construction Pieces:[/b]
[list][*]Accessed from the [b]Allforge[/b], players can select the newly added Decorations tab to build a selection of decorative items that will add some much-needed flair to your Viking homestead.
[list][*]Torch
[*]Brazier
[*]Horse Idol
[*]Dragon Idol
[*]Banner
[*]Chains of Fenrir
[*]Fang of Jörmungandr
[*]Shard of Surtr
[*][i]Note: All Decorations are unlocked as Challenge Rewards, with the exception of the Torch, which is available by default.[/i][/list][/list][/list]

[h2]General Crafting Updates[/h2]
[list][*] [b]New Consumables Recipes: Meals[/b]
[list][*]As of Inferno Saga and the debut of Survival 2.0, we’ve added an additional crafting tree for recipes; Meals! 
[*]Meals usually rely on natural ingredients and provide buffs and healing similar to Potions.
[*]Meal effects tend to be weaker in potency and immediacy compared to Potions, but can be carried in higher quantities.
[list]
[*][b]Sap Juice:[/b] Small Heal.
[*][b]Fish Skewer:[/b] Small Heal. 
[*][b]Grilled Meat:[/b] Moderate Heal.
[*][b]Marine Salad:[/b] Moderate Heal.
[*][b]Fish Platter:[/b] Large Heal.
[*][b]Coldproof Seafood I:[/b] Will grant you resistance to cold for 1 minute.
[*][b]Coldproof Seafood II:[/b] Will grant you resistance to cold for 2 minutes.
[*][b]Heatproof Seafood I:[/b] Will grant you resistance to heat for 1 minute.
[*][b]Heatproof Seafood II:[/b] Will grant you resistance to heat for 2 minutes.[/list][/list]
[*] [b]New Crafted Equipment Recipes:[/b]
[list][*][b]Villager Spear I / II[/b]
[list][*][b]Spell 1 – Leap:[/b] Stylish leaping thrust attack that strikes in a long line[/list]
[*][b]Alvíss’ Spear I / II[/b]
[list][*][b]Spell 1 – Flurry:[/b] Unleash a flurry of three rapid-fire attacks. Upgrades to Flurry+ at Rare Tier.
[*][b]Spell 2 – Healing Call:[/b] Raise your Spear up high and call down some Healing orbs.
[list][*][i]Alvíss’ Spear II Unlocks as a Season Reward [/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]Alvíss’ Armor Set[/b] [Epic]
[list][*][b]Armor Perk – Spear Up:[/b] Increase damage with Spears per equipped piece
[list][*][i]Unlocks as Challenge Rewards[/i][/list][*][b]Alvíss’ Stormguard[/b]
[list][*][i]Unlocks as a Season Reward[/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]Embers Spear I / II / III[/b]
[list][*][b]Spell 1 – Fire Spin:[/b] Spin your Spear in a 360-degree arc, dealing fire damage all around you. Upgrades to Fire Spin+ at Rare and Epic Tier.
[*][b]Spell 2 – Explosive Throw:[/b] Throw your Spear, dealing fire damage over time in the area it lands before eventually exploding. Upgrades to Explosive Throw+ at Epic Tier.
[list][*][i]Embers Spear III Unlocks as a Season Reward[/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]Embers Armor Set[/b] [Epic]
[list][*][b]Armor Perk – Fury:[/b] Stackable chance to increase move and attack speed after defeating an enemy.
[*][b]Embers Shield[/b]
[list][*][i]Unlocks as a Season Reward[/i][/list][/list]
[*][b]Surtr’s Spire[/b] [Legendary]
[list][*][b]Spell 1 – Fireball:[/b] Launch a powerful fireball from the tip of your Spear.
[*][b]Spell 2 – Ruler Dash:[/b] Dash forward and deliver a devastating area attack.
[*][b]Spell 3 – Lava Jets:[/b] Fiery blasts erupt from 3 separate points around you.[/list]
[*][b]Surtr’s Armor[/b] [Legendary]:
[list][*][b]Armor Perk – Ablaze[/b]: Stackable chance to deal lasting fire damage back at your attackers.
[list][*][i]Unlocks as Season Rewards[/i][/list][*][b]Surtr’s Ashguard[/b]
[list][*][i]Unlocks as Challenge Rewards[/i][/list][/list][/list][/list]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/24c4d6997864da1195868b2349e5fa459b15c73f.png[/img]
[*][b]New Creature: Lavættir[/b]
[list][*]A manifestation of Surtr’s wrath, these fiery elementals are born of molten flame and return to it upon death. They are vengeful to the bitter end. After taking enough damage, they will double into smaller, more numerous forms, until finally becoming highly volatile explosives unto themselves. Be careful when delivering that final blow.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/67732500cc71632c1ab558e9e46e3a95349594f7.png[/img]
[*][b]New Creature: Brennálfar Witch[/b]
[list][*]The Brennálfar have Witches of their own, and of course, they’re pyromaniacs!
[*]Known to stalk the Volcanic Spire, watch out for their fiery orbs; they’re slow-moving, but you don’t want to be around when one goes off.
[list][*]Rumors swirl that the most fearsome of Brennálfar Witches, Aska and Edlur, have made their way to the Volcanic Spire to protect their master’s Lair. These Elites will not go down without a fight.
[/list][/list]
[*][b]New Creature: Brennálfar Watchtower[/b]
[list][*]These fortified Watchtowers are the backbone of any Múspel invasion force. Capable of being built rapidly, they provide Brennálfar Archers with ideal vantage points and defensible positions to ruin any Miðgarðian’s day.[/list]
[*][b]New Creature: Fire Turret[/b]
[list][*]Dotting the entrenched pathways of the Volcanic Camps, these flame-spewing turrets protect the Camp’s treasure from foolhardy Einherjar itching for a raid[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/f239a9c89144f00d73ad169ef8e71c3340f68f9a.png[/img]
[*][b]New Creature: Múspelorm [/b]
[list][*]When two Linnorms fight, they use their massive tails to launch their opponents across unfathomable distances. Legend has it, no one truly knew where the losing Linnorms ended up, until now. Turns out, they were somehow launched into faraway Múspelheim, where over time, their forms evolved to not only handle the immeasurable heat of this Realm but to wield it as well. Now they’re back in Miðgarð, and they breathe fire.[/list]
[*][b]New Creature: Sormr[/b]
[list][*]Vile spawn of Jörmungandr that have slithered their way into the Open Seas.
[*]The Sormr will poke their heads above water to spit projectiles at any nearby Boats, so keep a watchful eye out when sailing your Drakkar. [/list]
[*][b]New Critters:[/b]
[list][*]We’ve added 5 more non-hostile wildlife critters to further flesh out the Biomes and provide an additional source of Materials like Fur and Feathers.
[list][*][b]Fox:[/b] found in the Bright Forest
[*][b]Hare:[/b] found in the Bright Forest
[*][b]Arctic Fox:[/b] found in the Glacier Peaks
[*][b]Snowy Owl:[/b] found in the Glacier Peaks
[*][b]Vulture:[/b] found in the Volcanic Spire
[/list][/list]
[*][b]New Camp: Outposts[/b]
[list][*]As part of Surtr’s invasion strategy, a number of Volcanic Outposts have been seen emerging across every Biome in Midgard
[*]These emergent encampments contain a host of Surtr’s forces that can be quick to overwhelm you if you stumble into one unprepared.
[*]However, if you manage to clear one out, their treasure chests are known to contain items of great importance to Surtr’s war effort. Would be a real shame if you were to use these items against him.[/list]
[*][b]New Camp: Volcanic Spire Camps[/b]
[list][*]Scattered throughout the Volcanic Spire are a number of heavily fortified encampments for Surtr’s forces.
[*]These entrenched Camps are a gauntlet of challenges, containing tight passages loaded with Fire Turrets spewing flame, Watchtowers firing on you from afar, and a whole squadron of molten defenders looking to protect their treasure.[/list]
[*][b]New Camp: The Lair Entrance[/b]
[list][*]The peak of the Volcanic Spire is the most heavily fortified of Surtr’s Camps. In order to gain access to Surtr’s Lair, you’ll have to ascend to the final steps, beyond a moat of molten lava, and defeat his two Elite Generals.[/list]
[*][b]New Ingredients: Fishables[/b]
[list][*]New Materials available at Mysterious Ripples:
[*]Cod
[*]Kelp
[*]Herring
[*]Salmon[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/dfc8170ee7f1e55d337bffc909df99940dd9fe3f.png[/img]
[*][b]New Runes:[/b]
[list][*]We have added 10 new Runes to bolster player options and provide new strategies. 
[list][*][b]Daughter of Ægir[/b] [Common]
[*][b]Chef’s Kiss[/b] [Uncommon]
[*][b]Ire of Oðinn[/b] [Rare]
[*][b]Night Owl[/b] [Rare]
[*][b]Bola Weaver[/b] [Epic]
[*][b]Mimir’s Well[/b] [Epic]
[*][b]Shrug It[/b] [Legendary]
[*][b]Fenrir Rune[/b] [Legendary]
[*][b]Jörmungandr Rune[/b] [Legendary]
[*][b]Surtr Rune[/b] [Legendary][/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ebe7942f9521d1d80454584521cc9774c351ad7e.png[/img]

[list][*][b]Nocturnal Starter Kit[/b] [Common]
[*][b]Gourmet Starter Kit[/b] [Uncommon]
[*][b]Boatless Angler Starter Kit[/b] [Rare]
[*][b]Harder They Fall Starter Kit[/b] [Epic]
[*][b]Dual Weaver Starter Kit[/b] [Legendary][/list][/list]
[*][b]New Item: Valkyrie Delivery[/b]
[list][*]Fallen on hard times and your Loot Chest is halfway across the world? Have we got the item for you! The Valkyrie Delivery consumable will instantly reclaim all of your lost belongings across all of your Loot Chests, returning them directly to your inventory, satisfaction guaranteed!   
[*]Can be purchased in-game for Golden Horns from any Sorcerer in either mode[/list]
[*][b]New Event Variant: Unsunken Prisoner[/b]
[list][*]Prisoner Events can now also spawn in the Ash Beach with Unsunken enemies having taken poor Ottó.[/list]
[*][b]New Rewards Track:[/b]
[list][*]With the official arrival of our third Season, a fresh Rewards Track is ready to be conquered! Gain progress by playing Tribes of Midgard to earn Season XP and earn bonus XP from timed Challenges. 49 new Levels and 49 new Rewards await, Einherjar!
[*]Season Rewards from the previous Season have been shifted to the Shop and can be acquired with Golden Horns.[/list]
[*][b]New Challenges: [/b]
[list][*][b]New Class Challenges x40:[/b]
[list][*]Centered on showcasing your mastery with each Class to unlock cosmetic rewards.
[*][i]See Cosmetics Section for details[/i][/list][*][b]New Saga Challenges x4:[/b]
[list][*]Centered on taking on the new Ancient, as well as managing to take down all 3 in a single World.[/list][*][b]New Survival Challenges x18:[/b]
[list][*]Centered on the new Survival 2.0 experience.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Added a number of Personal Quests that incorporate Season 3 features and locations.[/list][/list]

[*][b]Erik the Ram[/b] [Mythic] – Destined for greatness, this mighty fella is a symbol of the hardheadedness that comes with the job of being an immortal Viking protector.

notes.title: Season 3: Blessing and Combat Updates
notes.notes:
The launch of [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] Season 3: Inferno Saga is bringing many new updates to the game, including Blessing and Combat improvements coming to both Saga and Survival Mode! 

Ahead of the launch day, we wanted to share with you some of the improvements coming to Blessings and several Combat Updates we’ve got in store.

These changes, as well as all content from previous Seasons, will also be included for free in the Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch versions when [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] releases on those platforms.

[h1]Blessing Updates to Saga Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/6dd8d507af57a454302c6c6d64179d0684cf3743.png[/img]

With the release of the Inferno Saga, each of the 8 classes in Saga Mode receive 2 brand new Blessings, with some also benefiting from changes to other Blessings, as well as a layout overhaul with a better grouping of related Blessings.

Blessings are a vital part of [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i]’s genre-blending [i]Surthrival[/i] gameplay, and we wanted to take the opportunity with Inferno Saga to re-evaluate how each of the Classes performs and how the community has been utilizing their Blessings to create unique play styles.

We’ve been monitoring the feedback, pick rate, and performance of each of the Classes since their debut at launch in July of 2021. One thing we noticed was that a lot of what drove the popular Class choices came down to very powerful utility-focused Blessings like the Seer’s [i]Tempered[/i] and the Warden’s [i]Dwarven Made[/i]. We felt that these Blessings could lead to playstyles contrary to what we intended and have made some adjustments. But rather than focusing purely on these, we spent time looking at how to empower the other Classes to try to achieve the same levels of success that Wardens and Seers were… seeing. By empowering every Class to do what they do best, we can ensure everyone has a strong, capable Class that speaks uniquely to their style of play.

[h2]Warrior:[/h2]
The Warrior occupies a great mixture of offensive and defensive capabilities. With Inferno Saga, we wanted to lean further into each Class’s archetypal fantasy; with Warriors being adepts of Týr and the “best of the best” among a culture that reveres strong fighters, new Blessings like [i]Underdog[/i] and [i]Warrior-Gatherer[/i] felt like the perfect fit. We also updated [i]Reckless Roll[/i] to increase its value now that every Class is getting limited invincibility during their Evade rolls.

[list][*][b]Underdog[/b] [NEW]: Feeling surrounded? Great! Increase damage dealt per each nearby enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/58f387a6c9a4754c3991919b3373b97cf3a9fe90.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Warrior-Gatherer[/b] [NEW]: Labor like the Warrior gods of old! Combo attacks from any Weapon can now break Resource nodes, retrieving their precious Materials without Tools. Everything’s an axe!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/675c869a18c5363e0c0891acbe9ee7756be8f309.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Reckless Roll[/b] [UPDATED]: Now avoid damage throughout the entire Evade roll animation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/f707c96bc5e5260c3609de862a2113d6af7c6303.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Ranger:[/h2]
The Ranger’s damage really shines once you have some Equipment and Runes on your side. However, we noticed it was much more difficult for Rangers, as primarily Bow users, to deal with hordes of enemies due to the Bow’s more limited AoE capabilities. Both new Blessings [i]aim[/i] (ha!) to augment the Ranger’s ability to deal consistent multi-target damage.

[list][*] [b]Ullr’s Step II[/b] [NEW]: Ullr’s Step now triggers a rain of arrows on your original position, dealing [medium] physical damage over time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/824197230d1c3943546c1aaae5cabc272f6aa556.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Ricochet[/b] [NEW]: Each arrow fired has a 50% chance to ricochet, bouncing to up to 3 additional enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/21a836d9f7fbe3f6cdee7cfe7ffdc4965d5bcda6.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Quickshot[/b] [UPDATED]: Was originally affecting Arrow flight speed and now affects the attack speed of Bow Combo Attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/25f626cd3739d7f93702bb914299b8bf17647e43.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Guardian:[/h2]
The Guardian is our tankiest Class, as a result new Blessings, like [i]Unwavering[/i], lean into the stalwart stature of this immovable object. The [i]Pain Release[/i] Blessing is the Guardian’s main (counter) offensive mechanic, so the inclusion of a second tier that adds movement and attack speed intends to empower Guardians to explode from behind their shields and deliver devastating reprisals for a short time after unleashing their Pain gauge. 

[list][*] [b]Pain Release II[/b] [NEW]: Let it all out! Gain increased attack and movement speed for 5 seconds after unleashing your Pain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/909c6da2c7af5b1085de3fc7533fd3db2df6b7f9.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Unwavering[/b] [NEW]: The judgment of Forseti is absolute. Stand your ground against any who would dare say otherwise by becoming immune to knockback effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/1e36bf57a1f617d22dc05ba32b6af8696d09f910.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Seer:[/h2]
Our goal with the Seer was to empower support players, offering a Class with innate healing, improved revives, and crowd-control. The new Blessings for the Seer further reinforces this idea. 

We found Seers equipping the [i]Tempered[/i] Blessing turning into lone wolves that traveled out on their own into difficult climates, rather than sharing the support with the Tribe. To encourage the original intent of the Class, we have adjusted it to mitigate Temperature effects (rather than nullifying) and extended this out to nearby allies. You can still travel out into difficult climates easier than others, but now you can do it with friends! 

[list]
[*] [b]Yggdrasil’s Roots II[/b] [NEW]: Enemies entering the Seedling’s radius receive damage from the roots of the World Tree. Wouldn’t want to be on its bad side.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/9ecadab14fcb966c5ec843eb4ab6ae80ce67304e.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Sacred Revive[/b] [NEW]: Further empowered by the golden apples of youth, reviving allies now triggers a healing pool in the area, granting HP over time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/9b452861ff23f8f7d450120efb0d01e5853b4d44.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Tempered[/b] [UPDATED]: Now generates an aura that reduces Temperature effects for you and nearby allies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/6d205969ac509417a33e5771b9e05a424f0b3fdd.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Berserker:[/h2]
The Berserker’s playstyle is being an [i]unrelenting wrecking machine[/i].

As a result, we buffed [i]Battle Resistance[/i] to make them unstoppable as they shrug off 100% of incoming Stun/Slow effects. [i]Undying Anger[/i] allows them to spring back into action so long as they have some Wrath built up, and [i]Wrath Soothed[/i] rounds out the Blast-based Blessing chain, returning HP to keep the Berserker sustained while fighting wave after wave of enemy hordes.

[list]
[*] [b]Undying Anger[/b] [NEW]: Channel the rage of war. Automatically self-revive when down and receive healing based on your current Wrath.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/f359ffaa9db2ac2673172fa763911462280680cd.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Wrath Soothed[/b] [NEW]: Gain HP for every enemy hit by your Blast.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/bc4c962e18bb882e65351c37a25f81176dc9edc5.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Battle Resistance II[/b] [UPDATED]: Chance to resist Stun/Slow effects increased from 75% to 100%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/d07293e995b8b60215f52ac9039cf18f49cd427c.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Hunter:[/h2]
Skaði never travels anywhere without her trusty wolf, and now she’s passing that gift of companionship onto you! With the changes in the Season 3 update, we wanted to hone in on the ‘cunning rogue of the wild’ archetype for Hunter. They excel in combat through misdirection, traps, and other means of indirect damage. The changes emphasize this playstyle all the while keeping the Hunter out of harm’s way.

[list]
[*] [b]Skaði’s Spirit II[/b] [NEW]: Your Decoy is now armed with a Bow and will fire Arrows at nearby enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/3f03b83e2c07d55b764fe63fd6246df9a7122285.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Skaði’s Wolf[/b] [NEW]: Roll to deploy Skaði’s kindred spirit that will attack nearby enemies. Go get ’em boy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/162abe9b909a26cbf0f0c4c238a0f39013d94611.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Skaði’s Spirit I[/b] [UPDATED]: There is now a visual indicator to show the Decoy’s taunt radius.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/4cc5c69a0af7ae68cf741305d4491f1f62f5155c.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Sentinel:[/h2]
The Sentinel is a unique Class in that it relies heavily on its Shield-based abilities for its combat effectiveness. Shields are fun to throw around and with these changes, we have (literally) doubled down on that! These new Blessings should greatly improve the Sentinel’s Shields as their deadliest Weapon, especially when paired with higher rarities and the below updates to Shield Blocking for all Classes.

[list]
[*] [b]Shield Throw II[/b] [NEW]: Your Shield Throw ability now throws the second Shield in rapid succession.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/b1e1005334bf589d6f561153e8590d05197e6538.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Shield Ring II[/b] [NEW]: Shield spin to win. Your Shield Ring ability will now revolve around you a second time, dealing damage and effects twice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/41d891d2b7aa9223322a4319078363f72f0c5a03.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Warden:[/h2]
Warden was intended to be a unique type of support role, one focused on utility and logistics, which are crucial to success in [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i]. The new [i]Secret Stash[/i] and [i]Rationing[/i] Blessings further lean into this skillset.

However, with the original [i]Dwarven Made[/i], we felt that being able to bypass the Durability mechanic entirely altered the playstyle that we intended for the Class a little too heavily. With this adjustment, the Wardens will still be able to endure more Durability loss than other Classes, but the added perk of being able to Repair for cheaper will benefit both the Warden as well as their Tribe, which we felt was more important in order to emphasize that ‘village manager’ play style.

[list]
[*] [b]Secret Stash[/b] [NEW]: Vigilance is key when safeguarding a Village’s supplies, and their trade secrets! Materials carried are no longer lost upon defeat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/5faecaf7c55f4d4e93effa7b01e4472a54d654db.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Rationing[/b] [NEW]: An Einherjar knows how important rationing can be in dire times. Gain a chance to recover your Meal immediately after consuming it. Tasty!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/345a723c95bd2b383c7dad0886386395c4ed9bcd.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Dwarven Made[/b] [UPDATED]: Now reduces Repair costs & Equipment Durability loss by 50%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/2680db7209bc6b9f05b823bf5547fff0c0020462.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Blessing Updates to Survival Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/382f60dcc0bc9dc31195eeb611d0e614b7659cb5.gif[/img]
As mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/3368148492288843855]Survival 2.0 Blog post[/url], the Class system has been swapped in Survival Mode in favor of a brand new Blessing Tree. [b]90 Blessings[/b] will be unlockable as you increase your Character Level during gameplay. The Einherjar will be able to mix and match to their heart’s content for a unique experience that transcends a specific Class. These additional skills and changes will be included in the Blessing Tree for Survival Mode as well. 

[h1]Combat Updates[/h1]
The below changes to gameplay will be for both game modes in the update coming on August 16th. 

[h2]Invincibility Frames when Evading[/h2]
[i]You get an i-frame! You get an i-frame! Everybody gets an i-frame![/i]

Every Character now has an invincibility frame as part of their Evade action, allowing them to negate any incoming damage with a well-timed roll.

[h2]Animation Cancelling on Evading/Blocking[/h2]
We’ve tweaked our combat behavior to allow for more responsive timing when choosing to Evade or Block at key moments, even when mid-animation performing a separate action. You’ll still have to make sure your Evade is off cooldown, however, so roll with caution.

[h2]Changes to Mana Gains:[/h2]
Successfully blocking enemy attacks with a Shield will now reward additional Mana. The better the Shield, the more Mana gained! Guardians will synergize well with this change, as their [i]Refused Judgement[/i] Blessing will allow them to gain even more Mana per Shield block.

In parallel, you now earn a set amount of Mana per attack, regardless of how many enemies were struck in that attack.

[h2]Changes to Durability Loss:[/h2]
Similar to Mana Gains, your Weapon will now only lose a set amount of Durability per attack, regardless of how many enemies were struck. This will help to maintain your Weapon when taking on hordes.

[h2]Mana Loss from Powerful Foes:[/h2]
Action RPG combat is a big part of what makes [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i]’s genre-blend special, and with each passing update, we want to revisit our core combat mechanics to see where we can fine-tune to make it more in-depth, fun, and engaging. The improved Animation Cancelling and global i-frames on Evade rolls should go a long way in helping the combat feel more fluid and empower reflexes to get out of danger in a pinch. While the changes to Mana Gains and Losses should serve to help make each combat encounter feel more strategic in how you proceed. Managing Mana against a tough opponent will be more important now, and we hope this will make the fights all the more exciting.

After the update, being struck by Powerful Foes will leave you winded, causing you to lose a bit of Mana from your gauge. Powerful Foes include Jötnar, Elites (red skull indicator), Ancients, and the roaming mini-bosses of Midgard (yellow health bar, like Fossegrim and Linnorms). Make sure to watch those moves to avoid being hit! 

[h2]Changes to Bows:[/h2]
Our original intention with Aimed / Charged Shots was to provide the player with a means of holding their position when firing, as Combo Attacks move with each shot. We did not intend for Aimed / Charged Shots to outclass Combo Attacks in every regard and wanted the player to be able to pick and choose which type of Bow attack to use depending on the situation. 

The changes in the August 16 update make the Bow easier to use, more durable, and more powerful at all stages of the game while retaining both stances as useful. This will provide more agency for our [i]pew-pew[/i]’ers out there!

All this and many more, arrive in our biggest update yet, Season 3: Inferno Saga, on August 16. Make sure to read patch notes, releasing the day of the release, and the blogs on the new content to get all of the information on TribesofMidgard.com!

Seil seil for now,

[i]The Norsfell Team[/i]

notes.title: Season 3: New Features
notes.notes:
[i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] Season 3: Inferno Saga will be arriving with a GIANT amount of content on August 16! Today, we’re going over some of the HOTTEST new features! 

These changes, as well as all content from previous Seasons, will also be included for free in the Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch versions when Tribes of Midgard releases on those platforms.

[h1]The Ruler of Múspelheim: Surtr[/h1]
[i]What’s hotter than a whole new Volcano-themed Biome? THIS GUY![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/f61735a799d65731cf8874ca1884fc641628e371.gif[/img]
[i]The big, big, fire boi[/i]

Surtr, the Inferno Ancient, has erupted in the Realm of Midgard and is launching an all-out invasion from his Lair at the peak of the [b]Volcanic Spire[/b]. You will step through a fiery entrance and into an entirely new Arena – as expected, surrounded by thrashing molten lava.

Approach the [i]Horn of Múspel[/i] with caution, and do your very best to avoid Surtr’s vicious [i]Blade of Fire[/i].

[h1]The Volcanic Spire[/h1]
[i]A whole new Biome has been added to the world of Midgard, and it’s HOT![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/2feabeeeb1dd05926b4ddcb20bc478ae522d91e3.jpg[/img]
[i]We dare you to go for a swim in the molten rivers. We know you’ll do it anyway.[/i]

Every new World will be able to access the [b]Volcanic Spire[/b]. This molten landmass serves as the central battlefield in the Einherjar’s fight to repel the Inferno invasion and take down your biggest enemy to date. This area is only able to be entered by progressing through the new [b]Saga Quest: Inferno[/b], which aims to prepare you for the extreme heat (and threats) when ascending the Spire.

Complete with new musical scores and a unique ambiance, this dangerous new area hosts several unique creatures, crafting Materials, enemy Camps, and hazards ([i]looking at you, Lava Rivers[/i]) to traverse.

[h1]Saga Quest: Inferno[/h1]
[i]A new Saga means a new Ancient, and a new Ancient means a new Saga Quest. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ddc0785fafaf5cfbd9973ad81239048ec3df27af.png[/img]
A new Inferno Saga Quest will guide Einherjar on their journey to access the remote and dangerous Volcanic Spire. As part of Surtr’s invasion strategy, a number of [b]Volcanic Outposts[/b] have been seen emerging across every Biome in Midgard. These emergent encampments contain a host of Surtr’s forces that can be quick to overwhelm you if you stumble into one unprepared.

However, if you manage to clear one out, their treasure chests are known to contain items of great importance to Surtr’s war effort. Bringing these Materials to the Gateway is a surefire way to take a trip to his Lair. 

Once the Gateway has been activated, players must launch a counter-offensive to fight their way up the molten peaks and kick down Surtr’s front door before he has the chance to burn the world with his volcanic fire.

[h1]Wield the New Spear Weapon[/h1]
[i]Stabby, stabby… but from afar![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/1a83fe46b1eb6f9baa45b4a5cc00cd2391892764.gif[/img]
Einherjar have remembered an effective Weapon from their past lives, the Spear! Filling a gap in melee-style combat, the Spear offers considerable linear reach compared to other Weapons. They will be able to keep more than an arm’s length away while taking down enemies trying to get the best of them!

The starter Villager Spear is unique in its construction in that only Wood is required when crafting it. This makes it a great starter Weapon for those with nothing to hide fending off ravenous wolves like a true Survivalist!

[h1]Game Over Screens [/h1]
Game Over screens have been overhauled to showcase more elements and statistics highlighting your accomplishments during each session! The new flow contains three screens that you can review or skip:

[list][*] Global Results: A snapshot of the explored Map from the session will be displayed, along with a few highlighted stats, such as Time Elapsed and Enemies Slain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/1dfad30d92c3e5301d5bc6672df2d59e5fbcde0d.png[/img]
[*] Team Results: A grid that showcases all players in the session, highlighting their Character Levels and a top stat from which they took home the highest score.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/18ee5dc24a7275ec60ae0190f15740669efeada3.png[/img]
[*] Personal Results: A final showcase of all individual statistics accrued during the session, as well as where your Season XP is tallied. We’ve added many more stats to be showcased, including Souls Taken, Runes Found, and Damage Dealt. Like previous stats, these are all compared to your lifetime totals, for those who want to break their own records.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/4b411f6781f3a76a8a24ce92d85acc2981cd16c9.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Fishing[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/b71bb2713607c8a8dea6383f46e8f2ad334b73c1.gif[/img]
[b]Fishing Rods[/b] can now be crafted like any other Tool and comes in the same rarity tiers. 

To Fish, search through Rivers and Open Seas for [i]Mysterious Ripples[/i]. Einherjar will cast their Fishing Rod upon interacting with the ripples to start a time-sensitive mini-game. Interact again once the ripples have started splashing. If timed right, you’ll get several new fishable Materials to be used in new Recipes, including brand-new Meals (more on this coming in the Patch Notes)!

Look to the Patch Notes releasing [b]August 16 [/b]for a list of the Fishable loot and recipes they can be used in!

We are beyond excited for all of the new content releasing on August 16 with [b]Season 3: Inferno Saga[/b]. Be sure to follow Tribes of Midgard on social media for first looks at the new content!

Seil Seil for now,

notes.title: Season 3: Inferno Saga - Survival 2.0 Updates on August 16
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/9b0d482de641a8719717172c2c4f433391dd758c.png[/img]

[i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] Season 3: Inferno Saga launches on August 16 with a completely revamped Survival Mode!

Our goal is to create the ultimate Viking sandbox that blends our combined love for ARPGs, Survival games, and Norse mythology. Fans of both the quicker, Rogue-lite-inspired Surthrival gameplay of Saga Mode, as well as the slower, more exploratory pace of Survival Mode will feel equally served in updates moving forward.

[b][url=#survive]Survival Mode[/url][/b] has been fully rebuilt from the ground up to transform it into a more relaxed but equally exciting [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] experience. Some of the more time-pressure elements of Saga Mode have been stripped away. Say goodbye to the Endless Winter and Nightly Defenses, and say hiló to a variety of Helthings and monsters to hack and slash through in the wild!

The Survival 2.0 update now begins in a time before the Seed of Yggdrasil had a fully fleshed-out Village to call home. The Einherjar start off in the Sanctuary in a [url=#world]World[/url] without any Village, Walls, Constructions, or friendly Villagers to craft for you. Veteran Einherjar, Eira Foot-Crushed, is around to provide initial guidance (and protection!) on what you need to do - with help from some furry little friends along the way– see [url=#catorial]Catorials[/url] below!

We also had the absolute pleasure of being able to create an animated trailer to celebrate the new Survival Mode updates - check out our collaboration with [url=https://titmouse.net/]Titmouse[/url] here!

[previewyoutube=3uECm2p321g;full][/previewyoutube]

So what does an Einherjar without a Village do? They start building! The [url=#construction]Construction[/url] system was massively overhauled to allow players to create the exact homes they want. Not only in terms of features, with new capabilities like camera rotation and new Build Menu, but also in terms of content, with new Stairs, Doors, Pillars, Decorations, etc. as well as a wide variety of [url=#crafting]Crafting Stations[/url] for all the Builder Vikings out there.

This update to Survival Mode, as well as all content from previous Seasons, will also be included for free in the Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch versions when Tribes of Midgard releases on those platforms on [b]August 16[/b].

It will also feature a number of changes to core gameplay, including: 

[h1=survive]Choose Your Own Adventure[/h1]
Survival 2.0 is designed so you can play Tribes of Midgard at your own pace. There are many new features to accommodate this change in Survival Mode…but the biggest? There will no longer be a Village to defend every night! What else?
[list][*] Days will last longer at [b]20 minutes each[/b] to give ample time before the night. Note that seasons will keep on alternating between summer and winter.
[*] Helthings will spawn sporadically throughout the environment at night [b]but will not attack the Seed of Yggdrasil[/b]. They are still tough to take down but offer dark Materials and XP when defeated. Make sure you’re prepared if taking a night-time stroll!
[*] Each of the Jötnar have set spawn points located within enclosed Arenas that have to be entered in order to defeat them in open combat. This can be done at any time, and can be repeated with a greater challenge, provided you’re up for the task.[/list]

[h1=crafting]Crafting System[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/5dae9f1c9d30e0ae9a7b947669a89b576b541670.png[/img]
The crafting system in Survival has been entirely reinvented.
With no Village or Villager vendors, you’ll need to rely on yourself and[b] the trusty Allforge[/b]—a magical little Dwarven invention accessed from the Build Menu and placed anywhere, free of any Material costs—to progress and survive. The Allforge lets you repair Equipment for a standard Souls cost, and more importantly, instantly build as many Constructions, Crafting Stations, and Decorations as you can, anywhere on the map. Each player can only have one Allforge out at once, so simply craft it again to redeploy to a new position.

Once a Crafting Station has been built from the Allforge, it will show up in your Build Menu inventory. Use the Build Menu again to place the Crafting Station wherever you’d like and get crafting. 
[list][*] Need Tools to start chopping wood and mining iron? Use the Allforge to build a Tool Grinder and craft some Tools! 
[*] Are wolves getting a little too close for comfort? Use the Allforge to build a Weapon Furnace and fight them off! 
[*] Hurt yourself trying to sneak into a Dökkálfar Camp? Use the Allforge to craft a Meal Cauldron and get cooking with all new recipes to heal and buff your character! [/list]
Crafting Stations can be upgraded to unlock more powerful recipes and even entirely new Stations. They can be placed anywhere, including on the higher floors/stories built in your base. Once you get going, it’s only a matter of time before you have a Village of your own.

[h1=sagaquest]Saga Quests[/h1]
Saga Quests act as overarching objectives for players to progress towards. The first several Saga Quests will have you hunting down the Jötnar in their Arenas. Upon their defeat, they will reward players' Materials to further progress in the World by unlocking powerful [url=#creafting]Crafting Stations[/url], such as the Boat Dock, that will allow you to sail to new lands, loot better Materials, and take on greater challenges (even the Ancients themselves).
Ancients (formerly known as Saga Bosses) are the almighty bosses that are introduced in each new Saga. There are powerful rewards for taking down the Ancients:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/cab0d4ec3330844c3df91ec43733b30607ae1596.png[/img]
[list][*] [b]Sindri’s Foundry:[/b] Defeating Fenrir rewards players with a unique Construction that consumes unwanted Equipment and Runes for Souls. Invincible to damage and can be re-deployed at will like the [url=#crafting]Allforge[/url].
[*] [b]Freyr’s Ship:[/b] Defeating Jörmungandr rewards players with the fabled Skíðblaðnir, a unique Drakkar ship. Invincible to damage, can be re-deployed at will, and is the fastest ship in the game.
[*] [b]Heimdallr’s Tower:[/b] Defeating the Inferno Ancient (name unknown… for now!) rewards players with a mighty Watchtower and garrisoned Archer. Just like a standard Watchtower, the Archer can be equipped with more powerful arrows. Unlike standard Watchtowers, however, this Archer is stronger by default, the tower is invincible to damage, and can be re-deployed at will.[/list]

[h1=blessing]Blessing Tree and Level Progression[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/382f60dcc0bc9dc31195eeb611d0e614b7659cb5.gif[/img]
With the Survival Update, Einherjar will choose their skills through an entirely new Blessing Tree. The Blessing Tree is unique to this game mode and allows for more freedom to pick and choose from the 90 Blessings available. With this change, the max Character Level is increased to 50 to give more skill combinations during the increased playtime per World.

Shared Character XP for upgrading Stations or activating Portals has been changed in favor of personal Character XP gains for exploring and continual [url=#crafting]building[/url]. Players will work together to build a community and adventure through the land of Midgard.

While playing Survival, your Viking will come across Season XP loot. Season XP has a chance to drop from any activity that will also net you Character XP, such as defeating enemies and harvesting resources. Some methods guarantee large amounts of Season XP to drop, like defeating powerful enemies or raiding Camps.

Season XP is automatically attributed to your Account Profile in real time and contributes to your Season progression, no need to turn it in or Abandon your World.

[h1=world]The World[/h1]
The Worlds generated in Survival 2.0 are larger than anything seen previously and have been custom-tailored to the game mode. Players start on a large, central continent and will be able to explore the Open Seas as they progress through the early steps of their adventure.
Due to the increased player agency over exploration and means of travel, managing where your base is located will be key. There are a number of options to safely expand your dominion via crafting at the Allforge:
[list][*] Beds: Beds can be claimed to serve as Respawn points, which will come handy when facing your demise (being an Einherjar does not make you invincible!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/7bff859bf546d2183271c322c4c40f1b1727d5a5.png[/img]
[*] Bonfires: Bonfires will help keep you warm in cold climates so long as you deposit Branches to keep the fires alive. Very useful when landing on a cool Ash Beach in the dead of night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/7bedc69b8f7580db0b228274fcabbde1e79c02f1.jpg[/img]
[*] Shrines: Shrines act as Fast Travel points, allowing you and your Tribe to build your own travel network throughout Midgard!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/3a7fed830613fb9d76d9e25ebf3b2ae372b18f6b.png[/img][/list]

[h1=construction]Construction 2.0[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ab90a833a70fe3d06c4d163bb37f1cea88a11b28.jpg[/img]
We’ve reworked the Construction inventory to be more modular and significantly more flexible. Everything is scaled to fit a 1x1x1 area for increased interconnectivity. In addition to Grounds, Fences, and Ramps, new Construction pieces are available including Walls, Pillars, Roofs, and Doors, among many others. Each Construction comes in three tiers with different levels of strength and material requirements, ranging from twig/thatch and wood to slate/stone.

The camera is able to be rotated while in the Build mode, allowing the careful placement of Constructions while crafting your perfect mead hall! Pieces are able to be placed along the Z-axis for up to four levels, allowing for some cozy building while the threats are kept at bay.

Upset with where you’ve placed a particular Construction? Deconstruct freely with more accuracy with the Mallet. The Mallet is now triggered by default when in Build mode and simply highlighting a Construction will allow you to dismantle it. Deconstructing your Stations will return the Materials used to build them if you ever feel you want to entirely pack up and build out somewhere new. Further, this Mallet mode also gives the option to repair said Constructions. What a magical Mallet.

[h1=catorial]Tutorial Cats (Catorials?)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/372861fa8cd0de196c468e97dcea4e980f7a6ba6.png[/img]
Freyja’s chatty cats from the Tutorial, Sóleyra and Mániklo, make a triumphant return in the update on August 16!

To help guide you through a number of introductory systems in Survival 2.0, one of Freyja’s cats, changing depending on the context, will spawn when you interact with certain triggers in the environment, providing further context and even some tips as you get started on your adventure. They may be cheerful and snarky, but they're talking cats!

That’s all for now, Vikings - we appreciate your continued support and are looking forward to bringing this update to all of you in just one week from now! :D

Seil seil, and talk again very soon,
The Norsfell team

notes.title: Celebrating One Year of Tribes of Midgard! - Dev Blog #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/f5fbfe395586e6e0305d818e22294436a96d30ae.png[/img]

Hiló Vikings,

Today, July 27th, marks [b]one whole year of Tribes of Midgard![/b] Here’s to a year of Jötunn-slaying and Saga Boss-vanquishing, and to celebrating you - our community of steadfast Vikings who, since the start of development, have brought us unmatched support. 💙

To mark the occasion, we have a few words to share from our Creative Director and co-founder, Julian Maroda:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/6210b1ed4dc056d7537f696f07435809ab0bd633.png[/img]

The festivities don’t stop here. We’re also so glad to announce that we’ll be holding a special [b]Anniversary Event in-game from August 23rd to September 12th![/b] I wonder what awaits… 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/deefe753741d34e75d421e9cf4dae6941cff3c80.gif[/img]

[h2]Season 3 Coming August 16th[/h2]

Season 3: Inferno Saga will be releasing on all existing platforms, as well as debuting on both Xbox and Nintendo Switch on August 16th!

We can’t wait for you to see all that we’ve been cooking up. But for the time being, here’s some concept art for one of our new enemies you’ll meet in the new Volcanic Spire biome, the Lavættir:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/6b400c5dde1ef4361a6baa2f4ecc026b2de043f6.gif[/img]

[h2]Our Community[/h2]

As you can expect, we can’t wait to welcome all the new Vikings on board for the new Season. The past year, our community has grown to over 2 million players - an absolutely amazing milestone. We’ve also had some honorary (and furry) community members join us along the way…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/7a972d2e7ef32c2da3cf36db9ad03c71191ece1a.gif[/img]

Not to mention, there’s been so many great creations (you are so skilled!!). Here are just a few:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/98b94d0ab8344564d2d8f3a6d586b104085f4d9c.jpg[/img]

We encourage you to [url=https://discord.gg/tribesofmidgard]join our Discord[/url] if you have something to share of your own! We’re also currently holding a Discord event to give away some SHiFT codes, so now is a great time to join.

[h2]1 Year Celebration Stream[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c8ab095b8affdf1479b621e03673e8d6947e23dd.png[/img]

The festive spirit continues - we’ve got a special 1 Year Celebration stream planned for this [b]Friday, July 29th at 3:00pm EST! [/b]Join our Community Managers Sydnee and Alice, along with a special guest - our Creative Director aforementioned, Julian Maroda, who will be coming by to answer all your burning questions.

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard Season 3: Inferno Saga comes to all platforms on August 16!
notes.notes:
Hiló Vikings,

Today we have a lot of exciting news to share with you! We have been hard at work behind the scenes and now we can finally announce that Tribes of Midgard Season 3: Inferno Saga will be coming to [b]PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch on August 16th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/877b3347c98199a81e55b2c7381bbb59df0b0f4e.png[/img]

Season 3 is massive (our biggest update by far) delivering game-changing content, including a new Saga Quest, Saga Boss, Volcanic Spire Biome, Spear weapon (yes, so many of you guessed right!), Fishing, and more. Various improvements to combat, more accessibility settings, and plenty of quality of life additions (many suggested directly by you!) will also be part of this free update. Check out our Roadmap here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c6c6b1e4e947d71252d3ef0d85754abcf0c1a900.png[/img]

As we’ve mentioned in previous Dev Blogs, this Season will also feature a complete revamp of Survival Mode! Keep on reading as we’ll dive into a bit more of what that means below. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ea108aeabca6ad6877ead5ca8acc64cc690bd0cc.png[/img]

Still something we can’t believe we’re finally saying - on August 16th, Vikings on [b]Xbox Series X|S[/b], [b]Xbox One[/b], and [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] join the fight against Ragnarök! At launch, they will have access to the new Saga and revamped Survival Mode and will be receiving all future updates for free alongside the other platforms. We look forward to sharing launch timing for specific regions as we get closer to the launch date!

[previewyoutube=0WK0StvnYzA;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/908120440932235d736afa2350e33e0682269116.png[/img]

Also launching on August 16 will be updates to BOTH Saga Mode and Survival Mode!

[h2]Inferno Saga[/h2]

It’s getting HOT in Midgard. 🔥 Our new Season features a brand-new Saga Quest: Inferno. The Saga Boss awaits you in the heart of the[b] Volcanic Spire[/b], a location you maaay recognize from an [url=https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard/status/1522930637497376768]early teaser[/url]!

The new Saga Boss’ followers have set up Outposts across the land, hoarding the Múspelite materials, which can be used to open the Gateway to the Spire. Once there, you’ll have to endure rising temperatures, lava rivers*, and fiery foes as you seek out this new threat.

[i]*we don’t recommend adventuring Vikings swim in the lava rivers[/i]

[h2]Survival 2.0[/h2]

Survival Mode is being completely rebuilt for those looking for a more relaxed Viking Survival experience - an alternative to the urgency you’d normally experience with the coming of Ragnarök in Saga Mode.

It focuses on life long before the Village and the Seed of Yggdrasil came to be. You won’t be alone - our Viking warrior Eira Foot-Crushed will be your guide, along with our fave feline friends Mániklo and Sóleyra. As a reminder - Jötnar will not attack the Village in this Mode - instead, you head out into the world to fight them (and the Saga Bosses) on your own terms!

Some of its new features include:
[list][*] [b]No more Giant or Helthing attacks:[/b] While Jötnar and Helthings will no longer march towards your Village, they’ll be found throughout Midgard (along with Saga Bosses) and can be defeated for rewards.
[*] [b]No central Village:[/b] Free from the constant threat of incoming Jötnar attacks, Einherjar can write legendary Viking tales of their own, building their perfect Viking homes with a variety of new Constructions and Decorations. 
[*] [b]Crafting 2.0:[/b] Without a Village or Vendors, Einherjar in Survival 2.0 need to be self-sufficient to craft items. Utilize the magical Dwarven [url=https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard/status/1530535676218949633]invention of the Allforge[/url], accessible from the Build menu and free to place anywhere, no materials required. While the Allforge is valuable for repairing Equipment, its true purpose is to instantly build Crafting Stations, which allow you to craft and forge a variety of items depending on the Station type.
[*] [b]Choose your own destiny:[/b] You’ll be able to fully customize your play style with a brand new Blessing Tree layout, containing close to 100 Blessings otherwise contained to a specific Class. The Level cap will be increased from 10 to 50. 
[*] Much more we’ll get into very soon. 🙂[/list]
During this simpler time, new advancements in crafting require a new way to fight and gather materials. The addition of Spears will be a great asset to those starting out their journeys in Midgard. 

Fishing Rods will also be incredibly helpful in finding out what type of fish are living in the [i]~Mysterious Ripples~[/i] popping up in Rivers and Oceans. Both will be valuable tools as you survive AND thrive ([i]surthive, as we say[/i]) in Midgard!

Of course, we’ll continue to be posting more peeks here and there, and updates with more information on what to expect in Season 3 before it releases on August 16! We’re so looking forward to welcoming new Vikings to our ever-growing family. 💙

Questions? We'll be hanging out in the comments and on our social media, so don’t hesitate to let us know. Psst. We almost forgot. Here’s a first look at what you can expect…

Seil Seil,
The Norsfell team
