notes.title: Tribes of Midgard: Monthly Recap, The Allforge, and more - Dev Blog #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/bef436ec14b9bf6adee1c7eca16910ef778bdc37.png[/img]

Welcome Vikings, to Dev Blog #2!

April has been an exciting month for us, and there’s even more to come in May. Season 3’s development is in full swing, and we’re glad to share that we've just reached an important milestone in wrapping up our Survival Mode Alpha phase! Survival Mode’s development is coming along well, and we have more to share below.

We also want to take this time to share news about the Private Beta, some patch notes, what we’re currently working on, and what else awaits for May. I’m too used to saying “let’s dive into it”... so uhh... in the spirit of this “hot” upcoming Season, “let’s get cooking”? 🔥

[h2]PRIVATE BETA (PC)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/6b937b6c6aab7f8d4639e4ce7d53efe8e20b470b.png[/img]

With our new development phase starting, we’re excited for the opportunity to get our very first feedback on the revamped Survival Mode, as this will evolve with your help and input.

Our next Private Beta (on PC) will be held in mid-May, for all current and new Midguardians members.
If you’re interested in giving feedback, please don’t hesitate to join the Midguardians program. To learn more, visit https://www.tribesofmidgard.com/midguardians/!

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

Yesterday, we deployed a minor patch including [b]Doubling XP[/b] in both Saga and Survival Mode as well as increasing [b]boat health[/b] - be sure to restart your game to see the changes on all platforms. You can catch up on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/858820/announcements/detail/3224024423348187325]full notes here![/url]

[h2]SURVIVAL MODE INTRODUCTIONS[/h2]

Next, we want to (re)introduce some characters that will make an even stronger appearance in Midgard in Season 3’s revamped Survival Mode - it’s about time they say Hiló!

[h3]Eira Foot-Crushed ⚔️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/3566ed20513ac55974476406136def95f537752b.jpg[/img]

For years now, there has been a red-haired Einherjar featured on the Tribes of Midgard key art. She’s a powerful Viking warrior, named Eira Foot-Crushed (there’s a reason for that name… and we’ll get to that a bit later on). 

She’s been a constant figure since the start of Tribes of Midgard’s development, and has two armors created after her - both the Eira and Midsummer Eira cosmetics. 

Not only that, but she has lent her voice to narrate [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R1exn49Q8qs]several of our trailers[/url], and the [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLo81hPIPiU0wNP4ctlxbM2EE8r9hgS36z]Giant Showcase[/url] series. Did you know she even voices the introduction of the game, spoken in High Midgardian? She’s voiced by the talented [b]Camilla Arfwedson[/b], and we were fortunate enough to be in that recording session (very fun!!) to hear how it all came to life.

With all that said, it’s clear to us that it’s time for Eira to take on a greater role in our revamped Survival Mode - you’ll finally get to [b]meet her in game[/b] for the first time! She’s currently creating some… special Runes for you, so expect to hear a proper introduction from her soon.

[h3]Mániklo and Sóleyra 🐱 [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/63cd7c072ac0259f718dc090449c1b478c0c32d4.png[/img]

Besides Eira, you may also recognize our curious and fantastical Norse cats from the tutorial (or maybe they’re your favourite pet in game) - Mániklo’ (meaning “Moon Claw”) and Sóleyra (meaning “Sun Ear”). Mániklo is, well, a stubborn little deity, while Sóleyra’s quirkiness tends to surface with her perpetual sense of adventure. 

Since the Survival mode revamp will introduce many new changes and more to learn,  the tutorial will be receiving various improvements, including a more consistent interaction with our two cats. Mániklo’s wise words, along with Sóleyra’s effervescence, will be there to guide you along your first steps in Season 3, so you don’t have to worry about learning the ropes alone.

But until they can do so, we’ll give it a start!

[h2]THE ALLFORGE[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/89077fa4928fa9a0a0e54d5b586852d99efe0872.gif[/img]

We want to introduce you to an important element of the upcoming Survival Mode: The Allforge. This is a wondrous little Dwarven invention that can instantly craft Stations (you can see some examples of [url=https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard/status/1507731529405022209]crafting stations here[/url]). You’ll need the Allforge in order to create Tools, Weapons, Armor, and maybe even a heavily fortified village. 

It can be deployed wherever you’d like (fun fact: it can even repair your equipment). Think of it as the origin of all Stations! 

[h2]FISHING[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c8f0019614483fcb0d07cce5d26a12d04c84d9dd.gif[/img]

This has been lurking on the Road Map for some time, and with the new Survival Mode, some brand new resources have appeared just under the water’s surface!

Craft one of many fishing rods, and find the perfect spot to fill your pantry.

[h2]NORSFELL HAS A NEW HOME[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/eab5f1404a937b42c355926b734599fe3993a0d3.jpg[/img]

Okay, besides the in-game news, we have some IRL news! Some of our team have started working at our brand new studio (still under construction - we need some plants) after 2 years of working from home. Though we remain a totally flexible, hybrid-working studio, we’re glad to see each other’s faces.

You can bet we’ll share a studio tour once the setup is done!

You’re allll caught up now. We can't wait to start this month of May with you, whether it's with our new PlayStation Plus tribe, our Midguardians, or all the players with whom we'll be sharing even more of our journey to come.

Questions? Comments? We'll be hanging out in the comments!

Seil Seil,
The Norsfell team

notes.title: Patch Notes: Serpent 2.02-05
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/4be1c720ee9e715089ddd6ecc9597a807913ea1b.png[/img]

Hiló, Vikings,

We hope you’re doing well! We're currently hard at work on the revamped Survival Mode and all that's to come for Season 3, and will have more news to share about that very soon. :) 

Today, we’ve deployed a minor patch that does not require any downtime. Just be sure to restart your game to see the changes!

Here are the notes:

[b]Double Season XP![/b] ✨
[list]
[*] Effective as of this release, we are doubling the amount of Season XP earned in both Saga and Survival Modes.
[list]
[*] [i]Norsfell note: Over the course of the Wolf and Serpent Sagas, we’ve been tracking Season XP progression very carefully and have come to the conclusion that in its current state, it is slower paced than we anticipated. We want players to be able to level up their account progress while having fun in Tribes of Midgard, whatever form that takes, and without having to worry about optimizing their Season XP gain efficiency in order to chase those unlocks. We’ll continue to monitor over the coming months but feel this is a worthwhile first step towards making progression feel quicker and (literally) more rewarding.[/i]
[/list]
[/list][b]Stronger Boats, Boats, Boats![/b] ⛵️
[list]
[*] All Boat types have had their HP boosted by 100% and the maximum collision damage that can be received has been cut in half.
[list]
[*] [i]Norsfell note: We noticed that Boat durability was a little more flimsy than we expected, making it very easy to find yourself shipwrecked. We greatly boosted the HP values of all Boats to give them some much needed survivability so it’ll take more than a bump or two to end your Viking journey.[/i]
[/list]
[/list][b]Shop Rotation Speeding Up[/b] 👕
[list]
[*] To account for the increasing amount of content and offerings we plan to add, we’ll be speeding up the Featured Shop rotation to every 3 days, from every 7.
[/list]

[h3]Quick Reminders[/h3]

Be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/tribesofmidgard]join our Discord[/url] if you’re looking to find a tribe, or if you have any questions at all! It's our main community hub, and they will be glad to welcome you in!

As always, if you're experiencing any issues, please don't hesitate to let us know on Discord or through our [url=https://support.gearboxsoftware.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]official Support site [/url]- we'll be happy to help.

Seil seil, and see you soon,

According to French deals site Dealabs, PlayStation Plus members are getting three games as part of their subscription next month. The list is made up of FIFA 22 for PS4 and PS5, Tribes of Midgard for PS4 and PS5, and Curse of the Dead Gods on PS4 (though playable on PS5).

FIFA 22 doesn't need an introduction, and is evidently the highest profile game out of all three. EA's sports games, however, release annually, and we're likely a few weeks away from the reveal of FIFA 23 (which won't actually be called that), so it's not the best value.

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard: What's Coming Next - Dev Blog #1
notes.notes:
Hiló Vikings,

Today we’re very excited to talk with you about what's coming next for Tribes of Midgard, and how you can be part of it with us!

[previewyoutube=aa5o_4j3-Ks;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Journey So Far[/h2]

It’s been six months since Tribes of Midgard made landfall in July of 2021, but as you all know, making landfall is only the beginning of a Viking’s journey! Launching with [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zsocvKtnTMw]Season 1: Wolf Saga[/url], you and your fellow Vikings showed Fenrir who the real big bad wolves were. We followed up with a Mid-Saga update in October that introduced a deadly new Fenrir variant to defeat, new challenges to chase, new rewards to unlock, and our first festive event, Valhalloween. 

In December, we launched [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vHcp3u8moNM]Season 2: Serpent Saga[/url], introducing new features such as a whole new ocean biome, sailing, our Yulidays event, and the notorious Jörmungandr. Release after release, the world of Midgard is growing and we plan on continuing to do so for Seasons to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/3d9952b78a8894300cda1a98c932f9b8d3a78442.gif[/img]

[h2]Roadmap Updates[/h2]

After taking a hard look at our cadence of releases, we realized that Tribes of Midgard shines brighter with larger, more significant updates that offer players highly compelling reasons to return rather than a steady trickle of content. This is why we've decided to [b]no longer release smaller Mid-Saga updates,[/b] and instead focus exclusively on making each new Season as impactful as possible.

Next Season will be by far our biggest update yet! There is much to come with Saga 3’s debut that we’ll talk about as soon as we can. But until then, here’s a sneak peek of one change we’re particularly excited about...

[h2]A New Survival Experience[/h2]

We've seen hunger for a more relaxed gameplay pace. A mode where players can explore at their leisure, build freely, and soak in the world of Tribes of Midgard, all without the time pressure. The goal was for Survival Mode to fill that gap, but after reviewing our initial aspirations for the mode, as well as reading your feedback, it is clear the mode in its current state [b]hasn't quite lived up to its potential[/b] yet.

This is why, even as our team is hard at work on all of the epic Norse goodness of [b]Season 3[/b], including new features, new content and a massive new Saga Boss, we’re very excited to announce that we’ll also be debuting an entirely [b]reinvented Survival Mode[/b]! 

Here’s what you can expect:
[list]
[*] [b]Make your own Village![/b] Players will spawn in a World with no Village to defend from pesky Jötnar or Helthings and instead will grow by building their own crafting stations and settlements to establish their foothold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/1085c388d608eff2a4c5520e7a97267004200786.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Construction 2.0! [/b]We’re overhauling the Construction system to provide players with the tools to achieve that vision, with new pieces like roofs and stairs as well as the ability to rotate your Camera to help design your perfect home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/0f10843de78615ce36141bbbc8636d924e74b5df.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Create your own Destiny![/b] Players will benefit from a brand new Blessing Tree to fully customize their progression and unlock skills that would otherwise be contained to specific Classes. The Level cap will also be increased from 10 to 50.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/1aa20097785191d27d4faa4f8d0a18eef4faae1d.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Take over Ragnarök![/b] While Jötnar will no longer march towards your Village, they will be found throughout Midgard and can be defeated for rewards. The same goes for Saga Bosses. The hunters become the hunted!
[/list]

The journey is just starting, and we want to make sure that this new Survival Mode meets your expectations. So, to get it just right, we will need your help! 

[h2]Beta Testing[/h2]

At Norsfell, we believe in building our games alongside our awesome community, and we see the chance to forge something special together.

We will be hosting a Private Beta session on the new Survival Mode in the coming months with members of our dedicated community program, the Midguardians. We'll be counting on your feedback to hone-in on the feel of this new experience, both in Multiplayer and Solo.

More information on the exact timing of these tests will be coming soon, but in the meantime, we recommend going to[url=https://www.tribesofmidgard.com/midguardians/] tribesofmidgard.com/midguardians[/url] if you’re interested in joining the program and want to help us test the mode before its official release. We can’t wait to hear what you think. 🙂

[h2]The Journey Ahead[/h2]

We are beyond excited to dive into creating larger, more content-packed Seasonal updates moving forward. Season 3, with its many planned additions to Saga Mode as well as the brand new Survival Mode are testimony to that vision. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/afa1553256466db579d3732a4c86517b9169d9b9.gif[/img]

We will be keeping in close touch with you over the coming months about the development of Tribes of Midgard. Thank you, as always, for your continued support and feedback. We have the best community there is and can’t wait to give you a taste of what’s to come… careful though, it’s hot. 🔥

Be sure to join our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/tribesofmidgard]Twitch stream[/url] tomorrow, Friday March 18th at 3:00pm EST to ask us anything!

Skål!
The Norsfell team

notes.title: Season 2: The Serpent Saga
notes.notes:
Hiló Vikings!

Edit: Maintenance has concluded! Jump into the new content NOW! Season 2: Serpent Saga is upon us! 

[previewyoutube=vHcp3u8moNM;full][/previewyoutube]
This Season 2 update brings a TON of new content, Quality of Life updates, and changes to [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i]. Below is a long list of the changes that have been made as well as some information on the limited-time Yulidays event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/612cd5574cc87ed5f4636ce9c20337627b526788.jpg[/img]

Embracing the festive spirit with sharpened candy canes held high, the launch of Saga 2 also marks the beginning of our Yulidays celebration! Starting on December 14th and continuing until January 3rd, 2022, you’ll notice a wintery makeover to the Main Menu as well as some decorations laid about the Village.

[h1][b]There are spoilers below, so beware! [/b][/h1]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list][*] [b]New Biome: Open Seas[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/5df3afa6a28ac736d4d827b1a3647d5ebf66d828.gif[/img]
[list][*] The emergence of Jömungandr has changed the seas of Midgard forever! All Worlds are now generated with a far greater balance of water now populated with islands filled with dangerous creatures, rare resources, and valuable treasures.
[/list]
[*] [b]New Structure: Shipyard[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/dc506f5c6e0b42cfcee8371541fc3933b736ace1.jpg[/img]
[list][*] A new structure. A ruined Shipyard can be found on an Ash Beach biome located near the Village. Gather enough resources to rebuild the Shipyard, and you’ll be able to craft Boats from it directly
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c27bbf72a1e852cabab5c664adeb96a02ff1d8e8.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] [b]Boats, Boats, Boats![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/09002e80b69faa3887203eaa6e0ac440e0b35da2.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Having conquered the Wolf Saga, the Einherjar further reflect on their past lives as Vikings and the old ways. With renewed purpose, they remembered the lost art of sailing these majestic vessels across the seas.
[/list]
[*] [b]Swimming[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/8199713257b469cc1761c63bb21811f2726eb39b.gif[/img]
[list][*] That’s right, swim! Not only did the Einherjar recently remember the ancient art of sailing, but the crucial skills necessary to survive in a world with so much water—until they run out of stamina.
[/list]
[*] [b]New Saga Boss: Jörmungandr[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/513b2d1a5d2f5c6702b0a27b603b8498a8a72af1.gif[/img]
[list][*] Jörmungandr has risen! The notorious poisonous World Serpent resides in his Lair at the heart of the ocean, and if he is not stopped soon, he will consume all of Midgard in the name of Ragnarök.
[/list]
[*] [b]New Saga Quest and Saga Quest Selection[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/27b81662c0323372d1f4e0c67d48981f3fedb945.jpg[/img]
[list][*] With a new Saga Boss introduced, we’ve also introduced a new Saga Quest that will guide you on your journey to defeat Jörmungandr.
[*] Fenrir remains as part of the World, as is the Saga Quest to defeat him. If you’re feeling particularly brave (and fast), you can even attempt to complete both Saga Quests in a single World.
[*] Please note that during Season 2, the Jörmungandr Saga is selected by default but can be changed at the Quest Board at any time.
[/list]
[*] [b]New Condition: Poisoned[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/0dd3b490a288885ce0a37b7e70afd243c791f77e.gif[/img]
[list][*] Some of the newly introduced enemy attacks, such as from a Selkie’s claws or Jörmungandr’s spit, are capable of poisoning you. The Poisoned condition will slowly eat away at your HP and Mana if you’re afflicted.
[/list]
[*] [b]New Armor Perks[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ee1c083145fa80323b8f806c4378fe88ba82cced.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Saga 2 debuts the Armor Perks system. Every piece of Armor in [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] now contains an additional passive bonus.
[*] Each Perk is assigned to a particular Armor Set.
[list][*] You can also mix and match Armor Perks if you’re feeling creative. Multiple pieces with the same Armor Perk will stack the bonus![/list]
[*] Armor Perks per Armor Set:
[list][*] [b]Villager:[/b] Increase chance to receive double the loot from enemy drops per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Hersir:[/b] Increase Sword damage per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Raider:[/b] Increase Axe damage per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Feral:[/b] Increase Hammer damage per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Nornir:[/b] Increase Thunder damage per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Seiðr:[/b] Increase Damage against Helthing per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Útgarð:[/b] Increase Ice damage per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Gullveig:[/b] Increase Fire damage per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Serpent (New Set):[/b] Increase Dark damage per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Fornjót:[/b] Increase Damage against Jötunn per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Baldr:[/b] Regenerate HP every 10 seconds. Amount healed increases per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Fenrir:[/b] Increase Damage against Saga Bosses per piece equipped.
[*] [b]Jörmungandr (New Set):[/b] Regenerate Mana every 2 seconds. Amount gained increases per piece equipped.
[/list][/list][/list]

[h1]CONTENT[/h1]
[list][*] [b]New Creature: Seals (so cute)[/b]
[list][*] A new docile creature that inhabits the coasts of Midgard.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/07d79148bad2885e46e5f1cfd3f4a9e908d3a68c.gif[/img]
[*] [b]New Creature: Selkie (not so cute)[/b]
[list][*] Often disguising themselves as Seals, at first, these vicious creatures will lunge at you if you get too close and chant to slow you.[/list]
[*] [b]New Creature: Fossegrim (also not so cute)[/b]
[list][*] Armed with their trusty lyres, Fossegrims come bearing one of three magical songs that provide benefits to their allies in a nearby radius.[/list]
[*] [b]New Camps: Beacons[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/76938a1555b8cd534b6182b2c96252b3d1396c36.gif[/img]
[list][*] These unique Camps are fortified with a gauntlet of Turrets and host enemies defending a sacred Beacon used to light the way to Jörmungandr.[/list]
[*] [b]New Runes:[/b]
[list][*] We have added 5 new Runes to bolster your options and provide new strategies. See below for their abilities and how to acquire them:

[list] [i]Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop[/i][/list][/list][/list]

[h1]Balance Changes:[/h1]
[list][*] Jötunn pacing reduced to accommodate new world generation (smaller mainland)
[*] The [i]Nothing to Hide[/i] Rune’s behavior has been altered, in that now you only receive the Rune’s damage bonus if all Armor slots are empty, rather than an incremental bonus per empty slot. The total bonus damage remains the same, but you must embrace the full nakedness to wield it. Shine on you wild Viking!
[*] Rarity of Sorcerer & Merchant Treasure Maps changed from Common to Uncommon
[*] Personal Quests now contain a Treasure Map Consumable as a Reward to help exploration
[*] Harshest Winter Personal Quest’s Speed Elixir reward replaced with Immunity Elixir
[*] [i]Immunity Elixir[/i] can now also be found in the Ruins treasure chests on an Ash Beach
[*] [i]Villager Bow II[/i] can be found in the Ruins Treasure Chests
[*] Lair Treasure Maps can now be found in the last Treasure Chest of a Hideout
[*] Hideout Artifacts can now be purchased at the Smoky Highlands Sorcerer for Souls
[*] Jötunn Artifacts can now be purchased at the Ash Beach Sorcerer for Souls
[*] All Elite Creatures are now immune to status effects
[*] Dökkálfar enemy type now has Voidproof protection
[*] Unsunken enemy type now has Voidproof protection
[*] [i]Explosive Finale[/i] Rune Damage has been increased by 100
[*] [i]Might of Mjolnir[/i] Rune Damage has been increased by 100
[*] [i]Storm Chaser[/i] Rune Damage has been increased by 100
[*] Range of Baldr's [i]Blade Whirlwind[/i] Spell has been reduced by 100
[*] Lumberyard now produces 20% more Materials
[*] Farm now produces 20% more Materials[/list]

[h1]QoL Changes[/h1]
[list][*] [b]Shop V2[/b]
[list][*] We’ve redone the Shop layout and how items, old and new, are made available to players.
[*] Most notably, the Shop categories and their contents have changed:
[list][*] Firstly, based on your feedback, we’ve separated out the purely Cosmetic Items from items with Gameplay impact, such as Runes, Recipes, Tools and Starter Kits and made these Gameplay items available at all times. 
[*] By selecting Weapons, Protections, or Accessories from the Gameplay section, you’ll be able to unlock items from Season 1: The Wolf Saga using Golden Horns.
[*] The Essentials section now contains purely Cosmetic items for your Character Customization, such Hair Dye and Portraits and also includes Cosmetics from Season 1: The Wolf Saga, all of which can be acquired with Golden Horns.
[*] The Featured items will continue to rotate on a Weekly basis, but we’ve added the ability to select and browse entire themed Sets as ‘Bundles’. You can select the Bundle icon on the Shop menu to view all items associated with that Set and purchase them individually or grouped together as a Bundled unlock.
[*] As always, all Gameplay content is attainable with Golden Horns and Season progression only. In other words, Gameplay items will always require Gameplay to unlock.[/list][/list]
[*] [b]Auto-Equip V2[/b]
[list][*] Upon crafting a piece of equipment more powerful than what is currently equipped, the newly crafted item will automatically be equipped instead.
[*] Upon repairing a piece of equipment more powerful than what is currently equipped, the newly repaired item will automatically be equipped instead.[/list]
[*] [b]Donate Max[/b]
[list][*] When donating resources to any structure or vendor, we’ve added a ‘Donate Max’ shortcut you can press to instantly deposit all the required Materials and Souls, provided you have them in your Inventory.[/list]
[*] [b]Consumable/Construction Drop[/b]
[list][*] Players are now able to drop the number of Consumables or Constructions they want instead of their full stack. Works in the Inventory and War Chest.[/list]
[*] [b]Pre-Built Fortified Gates[/b]
[list][*] All game modes now have their Villages come pre-equipped with Level 1 Gates at all entrances. They can still be upgraded to Levels 2 and 3 per normal. This should help alleviate a lot of the pressure of the first few days of exploration as the Village will be able to take care of itself for a little while. Just remember to close the Gates when you leave the Village (hey, it happens to the best of us).[/list]
[*] [b]Personal Quests and the Quest Board[/b]
[list][*] All Personal Quests taken from the Quest Board will now skip the introductory step of requiring the Player to interact with the Quest NPC before they can get started on the objectives.
[*] Now, when selecting a Personal Quest from the Quest Board, your tracker will update with the objective right away and you only need to interact with the Quest NPC when turning the Quest in.
[*] Quest Rewards have been reworked to accommodate new content.
[*] Quest progress can be tracked on the Quest Board itself now, instead of disappearing after selecting a Quest[/list]
[*] [b]Matchmaking Region Selection[/b]
[list][*] Upon selecting a Matchmaking game, you can now select your choice of Server Region, or stick with Automatic, which will connect you to the fastest result as usual.[/list]
[*] [b]War Chest Arrows to Archer Tower[/b]
[list][*] Donating Special Arrows to your Village’s Archer Tower now looks at your Inventory as well as the War Chest, just like Gates.[/list]
[*] [b]New and Improved Alerts[/b]
[list][*] Session-wide text Alerts will now be displayed when a player:[list]
[*] Rebuilds a Village Fortification, the Bridge or the Shipyard
[*] Upgrades a Village Station, Fortification or the Shipyard
[*] Clears out all the enemies of a Hideout
[*] Light up a Beacon[/list][/list]
[*] [b]Steam/Epic Game Store Invites[/b]
[list][*] With [i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] now available on the Epic Games Store, players who link their Steam accounts to Epic Games Store accounts, and vice versa, will be able to send Invites to each other as normal.
[*] Matchmaking on PC includes all PC Players regardless of platform.[/list]
[*] [b]Game Over Screen[/b]
[list][*] We’ve updated the Game Over screen at the end of each Session to show some additional statistics:
[*] Golden Horns earned is now displayed
[*] Saga Bosses Slain is now displayed
[*] Seed number of that World Generation is now displayed[/list]
[*] [b]Hunter Class Unlock[/b]
[list][*] With the expanded World and addition of islands, we’ve changed the requirement for unlocking the Hunter Class from Activating all Shrines in a World to Activate 15 Shrines in a World to keep the challenge accessible.[/list]
[*] [b]Ranger [i]Slow Poke[/i][/b]
[list][*] Ranger’s Slow Poke Blessing has been improved so that the effect can now also be triggered by Bow attacks in addition to standard melee attacks.[/list][/list]

[h1]Notable Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed some isolated instances of a World spawning without a Bridge or Fenrir Lair
[*] Fixed an issue with Hunter’s Skaði's Spirit Blessing in which the decoy would not taunt nearby enemies properly
[*] Fixed some instances where players were getting kicked just after defeating Fenrir
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Linnorm were far too mighty and able to fling Giants with their tail swipes
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing Hálogi to get stuck at the Village Gates after destroying them
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Far-Fetched Rune was not adding the full damage benefit
[*] Kills made with Traps are now correctly attributed to the player and earn XP
[*] [i]… and many more improvements![/i][/list]

[h1]Known Issues Under Investigation[/h1]
[list][*] Boats may sometimes lose their momentum if passengers collide with the mast and/or the Player on the Rudder
[*] We have added the Seed number to the Game Over screen to help identify Worlds that have had rare generation issues that cannot be easily reproduced. If you encounter an issue in which your World generated with problems and you would like to report it, please note the Seed number from either the in-game HUD in the top-left of your screen, or just above the XP bar on the Game Over Screen.[/list]

notes.title: Epic Games / Steam Account Link
notes.notes:
Hiló Vikings!

With the launch of Season 2, we're excited to introduce crossplay between Steam and the Epic Games Store!

Step 1 - Link your Steam and Epic Games accounts:

Please [url=https://www.epicgames.com/help/en-US/epic-accounts-c74/connect-accounts-c110/how-do-i-add-my-friends-from-my-steam-account-to-my-epic-games-account-a3625] follow these instructions[/url] to link your accounts together.

Step 2 - Invite friends from the EGS:

In Tribes of Midgard, crossplay between Steam and EGS is enabled by default. But to allow crossplay invites, Steam users have to enable Epic Games Connection from the in-game Settings, as shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/6378ff4ab4a629f82429be0261afd25f87373fdb.jpg[/img]

Clicking on the “Enable” button will open a permission box in a web browser, as shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/97f5ea67e95eb63ba276767704e707db4bca3d0c.jpg[/img]

Once allowed, return to the Main Menu and click on the “Invite” button to see both your Steam and EGS friends. Yellow dots indicate players online while green dots indicate players in Tribes of Midgard.

That’s it! We hope you enjoy playing with your friends across both Steam and the EGS.

Skál!

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard's next season begins this month, with a new saga boss and boats
notes.notes:
A new season of Tribes of Midgard will start up this month, expanding the Viking game with new mechanics, new gear, new runes - and a fearsome new saga boss to hunt down and destroy before the arrival of Fimbulwinter. Season 2: Serpent Saga kicks off December 14, and when it does, prepare to take to the high seas.

Season two introduces new seafaring mechanics to Tribes of Midgard. The free update adds the shipyard, which you'll find near your village on an ash beach. Once you've rebuilt it, you'll be able to craft boat kits, which you can use to create a range of boats. These will prove to be important in season two, since you'll be searching for a new saga boss, which developer Norsfell hints is hidden away in a mysterious island lair.

While Norsfell hasn't said so officially, the 'Serpent Saga' title for the season suggests rather strongly that you'll be hunting down Jörmungandr, who is both a massive sea serpent and the middle child of trickster god Loki and Angrboða, the legendary jötunn and mother of monsters.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard Season 2: Serpent Saga
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/abe50ce5cc8e626e618a958d87ed69f186f4d77b.png[/img]

Hiló Vikings,

The time has finally come… and the sea awaits! [b][i]Tribes of Midgard[/i] Season 2: Serpent Saga makes landfall on December 14th![/b] 🐍

We’re so excited for you to dive into our newest, free seasonal update - featuring a new Saga Boss, Boats, a new Ocean Biome full of opportunity, new enemies, new weapons and armor, new Runes, Starter Kits, and more. We’re also kicking off a festive Yulidays event, and adding a boatload of additional balancing and quality of life updates!

And oh… almost forgot. You can swim!

[h1]The Serpent Saga: A First Look[/h1]

We’ll start off with a first peek at some of Season 2’s content! Here’s a quick recap - but keep in mind that this isn’t all we have to share, and you can check out more in the [b]blog post below[/b]. Stay tuned for more details as we approach the update, and for the full Patch Notes reveal on December 14th.

[h3] Swimming[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yes. We heard your Viking cries loud and clear - and have worked hard to implement aquatic exploration for Season 2. Your fate is now in your hands!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/83b1e7baca884b15b6c22fa474ab70e1b9c61c8b.gif[/img]

[h3]Shipyard[/h3]
[list]
[*] Similar to the Quarry, Farm, or Lumberyard, you’ll have to re-build a Shipyard to be able to use it. As you upgrade the Shipyard, you’ll gain access to new and sturdier boat kits, all of which will allow you to use your construction screen to build your boat.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/dc506f5c6e0b42cfcee8371541fc3933b736ace1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Boating[/h3]
[list]
[*] Three different boat types await you: smaller, more nimble Færings, a medium-sized Karve, and a glorious Drakkar. Each has different statistics for health, speed, and player count. The choice is yours!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/5df3afa6a28ac736d4d827b1a3647d5ebf66d828.gif[/img]
[h3]Beachside enemies and combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Not only will there be hazards in the Ocean, but be wary of the shores you explore - they’re full of new camps, and new enemies (more on that soon). 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/76938a1555b8cd534b6182b2c96252b3d1396c36.gif[/img]
[h3]Runes, more Runes![/h3]
[list]
[*] To help conquer your seafaring journey, we’ve added five new Runes. We’ll keep these as a surprise for now. You’ll now have 40 Runes at your disposal!
[/list]
[h3]A new Serpent Saga Boss[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sssshhh…. we’re not ready to reveal all the details surrounding our Serpent Saga Boss just yet. Let’s just say you’ll find this mythical creature of legend on a desolate island out at sea. I wonder who it could be?
[/list]
[h3]The Yulidays Festive Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] It’s the most wonderful time of the year! Our seasonal Yulidays will make its debut, featuring festive content including a pet, cosmetics, changes to the main menu and village, and festive challenges.
[/list]
Okay, we’ll stop there. Gotta save some stuff for release day! Be sure to check out the full blog post here for a first peek at what awaits you in the Serpent Saga: PS BLOG LINK.

[h2]The Serpent Saga FAQ[/h2]

We’ve got some quick notes for you before we splash into Saga 2:
[list]
[*] We want to give a friendly heads up for the brave Vikings out there, particularly those tackling the 100 days Survival Mode challenge; all Worlds will be reset at the beginning of the Season 2 update. Make sure to keep this in mind! A reminder will also be enabled in the main menu.
[*] Your [b]Season Level[/b] will also begin anew - but don’t worry - along with the remaining existing challenges, you’ll have plenty of new items to discover and new challenges to take on.
[/list]Expanding on Midgard:
[list]
[*] Season 2 [b]brings a brand new Rewards Track[/b] - so you can use this time now to progress in the current track. Items from Season 1’s Rewards track will then be found in the Shop for Golden Horns (exception of the Wolf Saga portrait).
[*] Sagas will build upon each other in every sense, meaning [b]Fenrir will still be available to fight[/b] in all the worlds of Midgard. You’ll be able to choose which Saga you take on at the Quest Board in your Village, and toggle the one chosen. 
[/list]
[h2]Our Updated Road Map[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/9dd25504c6be1ca4cbaa204e21f405f8c83ab39f.jpg[/img]

Our plans for Tribes of Midgard extend well into 2022 and beyond! As we keep on expanding the experience based on your feedback, we want to ensure that the release dates we communicate are accurate. Our team's well-being is vital for us and in a world filled with many challenges, we'll keep on updating this roadmap, one Season at a time. Thank you for continuing to be an awesome community, and for your continued support.

We’ve been hard at work the past few months to create this next adventure for you, and are eager to hear what you think of the update. To start off… what are you most looking forward to? Let us know! We’ll be hanging out in the comments below.

notes.title: The Vallhalloween Event has begun!
notes.notes:
Hiló Vikings!

It's time to embrace the spooky season with axes held high, as we kick off our first Festive event with Valhalloween! 🎃👻

This celebration starts today, October 12th, and runs until November 1st. Everyone and everything from Valhalla, to the Village, to the Goblins (and even some Helthings) will be showing off in this seasonal makeover. 

[h2]New Valhalloween Enemies[/h2]

First we've introduced new Helthings, called Val Helthings (...pun intended), and have given our well-known Goblins some very fitting pumpkin heads. A long time ago ([url=https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard/status/1322578722118127618]nearly a year ago[/url]) we toyed around with this idea just for fun, and now, they’re in Midgard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/7ef3763b67b0d150192c66106abe0c975b4353c1.jpg[/img]

You'll need to seek out and take down these enemies, to complete our Festive Challenges...

[h2]New Festive Challenges and Rewards[/h2]

There will be [b]3 Festive Challenges[/b] during this event!

Festive Challenge Week 1: Defeat 20 Linnorms to earn the Headstone Loot Chest! With Mid-Saga, we’ve added the ability to select your choice of Loot Chest to safeguard your inventory in the unfortunate event of your in-game demise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c9bbf88caddeeb93b58c7632a9d0b84789ab4173.jpg[/img]

Festive Challenge Week 2: Defeat 50 Val Helthings to earn the Little Stranger pet! This enigmatic little trick or treater just wants to make friends… or does it? We promise they’re here for the treats, not tricks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/48b57714742928bd8c6004e24aa701f7ce9bf66d.gif[/img]

Festive Challenge Week 3: Defeat 75 Pumpkin Goblins to earn the Valhalloween Portrait to commemorate your spooky spirit with. Take home a piece of the Valhalloween logo itself! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/d5e45ecdbd5018f219cbfb0013f939d5d0627000.jpg[/img]

[h2]Vanity Changes[/h2]

Valhalla and the Village themselves have seen some fall-themed changes, adorned with pumpkins to keep the festive spirit high. Plus, keep an ear out for some Valhalloween themed music while on the Main Menu or when defending the Village at Night! Beware the giggles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/a87519da16ed43fe07413fcba9c7e19e3db1f7c5.png[/img]

[h2]New Cosmetics[/h2]

Need a costume? Don't worry, we've got you covered. Be sure to check out the cosmetics below, which will appear in the Shop through the duration of Valhalloween.

[list]
[*] Linnorm Costume Set: Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop
[*] Headless Norseman Set: Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop
[*] Werewolf Set: Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/3d69ced2b52e89a94bb6c3beb3dd76155e810574.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fluffy Fang – an adorable little werewolf pup that’s eager to explore Midgard: Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/eb32109c58247e2d7ec243c01e60e7086945bebc.gif[/img]

Last, make sure to join our Discord to meet up with players, and to let us know what you think! Many of the improvements made during the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858820/view/2908753426142380492]Mid Saga 1 update[/url] were community-driven, and we want you to know we’re keeping an eye on your suggestions and feedback. We look forward to hearing more.

Stay safe out there, stay spooky, and don't let the Úlfurs bite.

Until next time,
The Norsfell Team

notes.title: Mid-Season 1: The Wolf Saga is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,

Today’s the day – our first Mid Saga Update is here, and we’ve got plenty of exciting news to share! We can’t wait to see you all dig into the newness of Midgard, including our Valhalloween event that kicks off October 12th. Let’s dive into just some of what you can expect during the Mid Saga.

In this update (live at 10am ET/7am PT), you’ll encounter the debut of our Saga Boss Variant system! The wolf formerly known as simply Fenrir is now: Doomhowler. We also introduce a new addition named Wolfmancer Fenrir. Expect each variant to have a unique look, abilities and more – read up on them in the full notes below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/1d1dd1302f1884103201723fe765767de08cf4f2.jpg[/img]

Along with 5 new Runes to discover, we’ve added 3 new Starter Kits to provide more options for changing up your strategies in Midgard. Check them out below! You can also see the [url=https://www.tribesofmidgard.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/ToM_35Runes_1920x1080-1024x576.png]NEW FULL rune resource image here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/4f44ede00778cb1b67c2ecefeafced209f5b7487.png[/img]

This update also brings 5 new cosmetic sets which will rotate through the Shop. First up: the V1.K1.NG set, then during Valhalloween we’ll have 3 sets in rotation (see Valhalloween section below). Last, the Monkey King set will appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/bd2d6679970c6cb52c9f321288adec5e5e1be201.jpg[/img]

Spooky season is upon us! The Valhalloween event brings 3 new cosmetic sets: Linnorm costume, Headless Norseman, and Werewolf. And among visual changes, we’ve added new enemies: Val Helthings and Pumpkin Goblins, who present festive challenges to complete.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/5c346625d289a464a20f977609c3d4def8409545.jpg[/img]

We wanted to mention a few particular QoL additions that were brought up by our community:

[list][*] When players Abandon their game, or exit via the Bifrost, their entire loot is automatically deposited into the War Chest.
[*] A screen-shake on/off option is now available.
[*] Players can now choose if the Waystone activation is a toggle (default) or a hold.
[*] We’re looking forward to seeing you explore the updated world of Midgard! Thank you for your continued support. We’ll be out here listening to your feedback, so be sure to let us know what you think.[/list]
Lastly, be sure to read the FULL detailed notes for the update below!

We’re keeping an eye on player feedback and investigating known issues that have been reported. You can visit our Discord for a list of issues reported by the community. Please report any ongoing issues to our Support site here.

Until next time,
[i]The Norsfell Team[/i]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list][*] Fenrir Variants
[list]
[*] With our first Mid-Saga update comes the debut of our Saga Boss Variant system. Now, when starting a new World, there is a 50/50 chance that you will encounter one of two Fenrir variations at the end of your Saga Quest. Keep an eye out for visual differences in the Myth Lair entrance and the Arena itself to foreshadow which version you’ll be facing off against. See Content section below for more details.
[/list]
[*] New Challenge Types:
[list]
[*] We’ve added recurring Daily and Weekly Challenge types that can be completed for continual rewards, such as Golden Horns and Season XP to help progress you through the Season Rewards track.
[/list][/list]
[h1]Content[/h1][list]
[*] Wolfmancer Fenrir:
[list][*] Sporting a fresh look, this new Fenrir Variant never fights alone, for he is a master of magic… wolf magic! Throughout your encounter with Wolfmancer Fenrir, he will summon his wolf allies to distract and overwhelm you, in addition to attacking you directly (he fights dirty). Should Wolfmancer Fenrir be reduced to 50% HP, he will call for aid from his most trustworthy of wolf allies, the gigantic and deadly Sköll and Hati. Good luck![/list]
[*] Doomhowler Fenrir:
[list][*] The wolf formerly known simply as Fenrir has taken up the new mantle of Doomhowler. Why? Well, because he’s honed his signature Howl ability to be even more deadly (doomful?). When below the 50% HP threshold, Doomhowler Fenrir will shoot out magical projectiles in all directions every time he uses his Howl ability. Stay nimble and you might just make it through in one piece.[/list]
[*] New Challenges:
[list][*] To accompany the additions of New Challenge types and the new Fenrir Variants, we’ve added a multitude of challenges for players to complete and earn rewards from. Be sure to check out the Challenges from the Progress tab on the Main Menu to see what we’ve added, including:
[list][*] New Saga Challenges – take down the Fenrir Variants by the set times to earn your rewards!
[*] New Daily and Weekly Challenges – complete these regularly to earn extra Golden Horns and large amounts of Season XP![/list][/list]
[*] New Runes:
[list][*] We have added 5 powerful new Runes for you to play around and experiment with. See below for their abilities and how to acquire them:
[list][*] Life Loot [Common]: Defeated enemies have a 20% chance to generate [1] orb that grants 200 HP.
[list][*] [i]Unlocked by completing a new Saga Challenge[/i][/list]
[*] Björn Aghast [Uncommon]: Reviving an ally triggers an explosion that deals [high] physical damage.
[list][*] [i]Unlocked by completing a new Saga Challenge[/i][/list]
[*] Making Waves [Uncommon]: Shielding for 3 seconds triggers a shockwave that deals [medium] physical damage.
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop[/i][/list]
[*] Storm Chaser [Rare]: Combo attacks have a 5% chance to generate [1] magical orb that seek out enemies, exploding for [medium] Thunder damage.
[list][*] [i]Unlocked by completing a new Saga Challenge[/i][/list]
[*] Bomb Voyage [Epic]: Combo attacks have a 10% chance to stick a timed bomb on an enemy that deals [medium] physical damage after a short delay.
[list][*][i] Unlocked by completing a new Saga Challenge[/i][/list][/list][/list]
[*] New Starter Kits:
[list][*] We have added 3 Starter Kits to provide more options for changing up your strategies in Midgard. See below for their contents and how to acquire them:
[list][*] Shield Offense Starter Kit [Common]: Equip this Starter Kit to begin a new World with Shivered Shield III x1 and Making Waves Rune x1.
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop[/i][/list]
[*] Life Giver Starter Kit [Uncommon]: Equip this Starter Kit to begin a new World with Healing Brew x1 and Life Loot Rune x1.
[list][*] [i]Unlocked by completing a new Saga Challenge[/i][/list]
[*] Life & Death Starter Kit [Rare]: Equip this Starter Kit to begin a new World with Last Laugh Rune x1 and Björn Aghast Rune x1.
[list][*][i] Unlocked by completing a new Saga Challenge[/i][/list][/list][/list]
[*] New Cosmetic Sets:
[list][*] V1.K1NG – Armor x5 and Equipment x5[list]
[*][i]Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop[/i][/list]
[*]Monkey King – Armor x5 and Equipment x5.[list]
[*][i] Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i][/list][/list]
[*] New Pet:
[list][*] Cloud King – equal parts regal and mischievous, this monkey flies atop the clouds themselves.[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i][/list][/list][/list]
[h1]Valhalloween Event – October 12th to November 1st[/h1]
[list][*] Valhalloween:
[list][*] Embracing the spooky season with axes held high, we’ll be kicking off our first Festive event with Valhalloween! This celebration will start on October 12th, and everyone and everything from Valhalla, to the Village, to the Goblins (and even some Helthings) will be showing off a seasonal makeover. Keep an ear out for some Valhalloween themed music as well while on the Main Menu or when defending the Village at Night.[/list]
[*] Festive Challenges:
[list][*] During the Valhalloween Event from October 12th to November 1st, there will be 3 Festive Challenges that can only be completed during this limited time event.
[*] Complete these challenges to earn unique Valhalloween Content, see Valhalloween Content below for details.[/list]
[*] Headstone Loot Chest
[list][*] With Mid-Saga we’ve added the ability to select your choice of Loot Chest to safeguard your inventory in the unfortunate event of your in-game demise.
[*] Our first new Cosmetic Loot Chest is the Headstone Loot Chest, just in time for Valhalloween.
[list][*] [i]Unlocked by completing a Festive Challenge during Vahalloween[/i][/list][/list]
[*] Valhalloween Cosmetics
[list][*] Linnorm Costume: Armor x5 and Equipment x5
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop[/i][/list]
[*] Headless Norseman: Armor x5 and Equipment x5
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Golden Horns in the Shop[/i][/list]
[*] Werewolf: Armor x5 and Equipment x5
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i][/list]
[*] Valhalloween Portrait:
[list][*] [i]Unlocked by completing a Festive Challenge during Valhalloween[/i][/list]
[*] Valhalloween Pets:
[list][*] Little Stranger – this enigmatic little trick or treater just wants to make friends… or does it?[list]
[*] [i]Unlocked by completing a Festive Challenge during Valhalloween[/i][/list]
[*] Fluffy Fang – an adorable little werewolf pup that’s eager to explore Midgard.
[list][*] [i]Unlocked with Platinum Coins in the Shop[/i][/list][/list][/list][/list]
[h1]Gameplay Changes – Combat/Blessings Update[/h1]
[list][*] Armor System Update:
[list][*] We have globally buffed Armor and Shields’ impact on mitigating damage to the player, affecting all tiers of Equipment. Due to this, the Defense rating on Armor, and any Runes or Blessings that further buff that Rating, will be more noticeable and do a better job of keeping you safe out there in Midgard.[/list]
[*] Class Blessings
[list][*] Ranger:
[list][*] Ullr’s Step: reduced the cooldown and added a stun effect.[/list]
[*] Hunter:
[list][*] Skaði’s Spirit: now spawns 100% of the time, with a cooldown between uses, and continually taunts nearby enemies.
[*] Bountiful Grasp: now doubles all Materials harvested regardless of source.
[*] Pushing Limits: increased the knockback effect but only triggers on the final combo hit.[/list]
[*] Warrior:
[list][*] Reckless Roll: Now working as intended in that it does not affect the entire rolling animation. Added a visual cue to indicate the timing during the roll in which the Warrior is invincible.[/list]
[*] Berserker:
[list][*] Striking Fear: No longer affects weapon durability when triggered.
[*] Wrath Unleashed: Adjusted the Blessing Tree layout so that this Blessing is more of a conscious decision for players if they want to expend their Wrath gauge for the explosion damage or not.[/list]
[*] Sentinel:
[list][*] Shield Throw: Now correctly bounces up to 3 additional targets.[/list]
[*] Combat Improvements:
[list][*]Pressing inputs before the end of Rolling, Bow aiming and Shield blocking animations now skips recovery and feels more responsive.
[*] Blocking stance effect is now active immediately upon pressing the input, even if the animation is not finished.
[*] Cooldowns of Class Spells are now always visible in the HUD.[/list][/list][/list]
[h1]Balance Changes:[/h1]
[i]Norsfell: We’ve been monitoring the playstyles and emerging meta strategies from the Community since launch, and with the Mid-Saga update we wanted to empower players with a wider variety of suitable options to shake up that meta and add some more diversity to player builds. This included taking a look at some Runes that we felt were not strong enough on their own, leading to the game being harder than anticipated without the ideal Rune setup. The Rune changes below, coupled with the Armor System Update above, should allow for a wider variety of powerful builds to take on the dangers of Midgard with.[/i]
[list][*] Rune Effects:
[list][*] Einher-a-JAR: damage bonus changed from 50% to 75%
[*] Blessed Hands: XP on Loot value changed from 300 to 400
[*] Beyond Repair: discount value changed from 15% to 25%
[*] Ire of Thór: damage buff changed from 10% to 15%
[*] Lucky Loot: bonus changed from 15% to 20%
[*] Viking Hoarder: bonus changed from 20% to 25%
[*] Keeper of Souls: bonus changed from 20% to 25%
[*] Explosive Finale: bonus changed from 10% to 15%
[*] Rolling Thunder: damage changed from 200 to 300
[*] Last Laugh: damage changed from 2000 to 3000
[*] Demolition Viking: damage changed from 1000 to 2000
[*] Björn Again: heal value changed from 1000 to 1750
[*] Might of Mjölnir: damage changed from 100 to 200
[*] Like a Dwarf: armor value bonus changed from 50 to 150
[*] Coldblood: heal value changed from 50 to 75[/list]
[*] Rune Rarities:
[list][*] Demolition Viking: changed from Rare to Uncommon
[*] Viking Hoarder: changed from Epic to Uncommon
[*] Seiðr Weaver: changed from Rare to Epic
[*] Soul Powered: changed from Uncommon to Epic
[*] Nothing to Hide: changed from Uncommon to Rare[/list]
[*] Crafting:
[list]
[*] Legendary Weapons that do not require previous Weapon tiers in their Recipe have an increased Golden Horns Cost from 1 to 4 to make the resource investments more equal across Legendaries.
[list]
[*] [i]Norsfell: Worth noting that with the addition of Daily Challenges, players will have even more opportunities to earn Golden Horns on a regular basis for spending on Crafting, at the Golden Altar, or in the Shop[/i].[/list][/list][/list]
[h1]QoL Changes[/h1]
[list][*] War Chest Loot:
[list][*] When players Abandon a Multiplayer game from within one, or take the Bifröst, their entire loot is automatically deposited into the War Chest and can be accessed by the remaining players. An Exit Alert message has also been added to clarify the manner of players’ exits and states that their Inventory has been transferred to the War Chest.[/list]
[*] Explosive Jar Placement:
[list][*] When placing an Explosive Jar, it now appears behind the character instead of in front of it, allowing players to more easily set traps while fleeing the enemy.[/list]
[*] Village Shrine:
[list][*] When at a Shrine and choosing your destination, pressing the CTRL (PC) / Triangle (PlayStation) button causes the cursor to center exactly on the Village Shrine to allow for faster teleporting home[/list]
[*] Quest Board Organization:
[list][*] Quests listed in the Quest Board are now organized by difficulty, from easiest to hardest.[/list]
[*] Bifröst Pop-Up:
[list][*] When exiting through the Bifröst, the default button selected is now Yes instead of No, allowing players to quickly leave the game and bank those rewards when time is nigh.[/list]
[*] Screen Shake Toggle:
[list][*] Players can now toggle On (default) or Off this option from the Settings menu.[/list]
[*] Waystone Activation:
[list][*] Players can also now choose if the activation for their Waystone is a Toggle (default) or a Hold input.[/list]
[*] Loot Chest Angle:
[list][*] Loot Chests that spawn when a player’s Viking dies will now spawn at a default 45 degree angle to ease visualization.[/list]
[*] Accessories Tab:
[list][*] We’ve reworked the Customize menu, adding an Accessories Tab to house the player’s choice of Starter Kits, Pets, and now Loot Chests.[/list][/list]
[h1]Notable Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] We have pinpointed a number of issues affecting the performance of PS5 users. We’ve made some changes that should result in a notable performance improvement and will continue to optimize all versions of Tribes of Midgard with future updates to present the best looking, and best playing, experience possible.
[*] Fixed an issue where level 50 players would only see their level as 49 in-game
[*] Fixed some instances of players experiencing an infinite load at times of high latency
[*] Fixed a number of instances in which Rune effects would not stack properly
[*] [i]… and many more improvements![/i][/list]
[h1]Known Issues Under Investigation[/h1]
[list][*] We are actively looking into an issue that affected ongoing Survival games by multiplying the enemy Jötunn’s health bar to infinity and beyond. Starting a new World resolves this issue, but we are gathering insight from the community in an effort to resolve this issue as soon as possible.
[*] We are looking into a rare issue of Worlds being generated in a broken state, with landmasses overlapping each other.[/list]

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard classes - how to unlock each class
notes.notes:
Want to know how to unlock every class in Tribes of Midgard? There are eight different classes in Tribes of Midgard, though only two are available at the start of the RPG game. Most of these challenges require you to go out of your way to complete them, you won't unlock the classes just by playing the game.

Unlocking every class can be a pain, especially at the beginning of the game when your tribe consists entirely of Rangers and Warriors. You can have up to ten players in your tribe - it helps to diversify your classes in order to maximise your damage output. Unlocking new classes brings completely different elements to the table, allowing you to create powerful synergies and deadly combos.

We've assembled the easiest methods to unlock each of the classes. Be warned, some of the methods take some skill to accomplish. You won't be able to unlock every class right from the beginning, but you should be able to unlock a decent number of them early on.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard has reached over 250k players
notes.notes:
Tribes of Midgard is a Gearbox-published action co-op survival RPG that came out last week, July 27 to be exact, to general acclaim - and it's apparently already brought in over 250,000 players across PC and consoles.

The game - inspired by the likes of Don't Starve Together and some of the other great survival games on PC - launched on July 27 for PS4, PS5, and PC via Steam, and has done pretty well on Steam since then. According to SteamDB, Tribes of Midgard's concurrent player counts have been consistently going up since release - with a new peak reached just yesterday evening with 30,930 concurrent players.

It was the number four bestselling game on Steam last week, just under cyberpunk RPG The Ascent and two versions of Amazon's MMO New World - which is currently wrapping up its closed beta before the release at the end of the month, so Tribes of Midgard actually has a chance to go up the charts this week if this momentum continues.

notes.title: Tribes Of Midgard could be the second smash hit co-op viking game this year
notes.notes:
Yet another viking adventure has set sail to some strong tail winds, proving that folks are still plenty hungry for more Norse adventures. Action slash 'em up, Tribes Of Midgard just launched yesterday and is already seeing concurrent viking numbers that rival the early days of explosive early access viking hit Valheim earlier this year. We could have another lodestone on our hands, judging by the 25,000 players already jumping in just on PC.

Read more

notes.title: If you play Tribes of Midgard solo, prepare to get stomped
notes.notes: If you're thinking of playing Tribes of Midgard solo, prepare for an extremely challenging experience—especially for your first several runs. The co-op Viking ARPG is a hectic session-based game with a blisteringly fast pace and a dozen different things to do at any given moment. And when you're trying to do all those things solo, it can be downright overwhelming... Read more.

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard is now available! (Server issue resolved + Launch event)
notes.notes:
Hilo Vikings,

After four years of development, we're so excited to announce that [b]Tribes of Midgard is now available on PlayStation and Steam[/b]!

We can't wait to hear what you think of Tribes of Midgard, and hope you're ready to jump into Season One: The Wolf Saga.

[h2]Watch the launch trailer here:[/h2]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xdzmhjUceeA
[h3]Launch Day Server fixes[/h3]

We were aware some players experienced server issues just after our launch. We apologize for this, and moved quick as we could to resolve the issue by upgrading our servers. Things are looking stable and there should be no more issues! Thank you so much for your patience, really, everyone at the team much appreciates your understanding. 

[h3]One Tree Planted Event[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/966b67de690bfd14dbdcdc45705a1b6427f03129.png[/img]

Lastly, be sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/tribesofmidgard]join our Discord[/url] to find a tribe to play with, and come [url=https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard]hang out on our Twitter[/url] for all the latest news.

The entire Norsfell team is beyond thrilled that today has finally come. We'll be keeping an eye out for your feedback as always! Thank you for all the support these past few years, we could not have done this without our awesome community.

The Norsfell Team 🗻

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard: How to climb cliffs with ramps
notes.notes: Wondering how to climb cliffs in Tribes of Midgard? As you explore the procedurally generated world in the co-op Viking ARPG, you'll run into a lot of cliffs and plateaus scattered around the landscape. These cliffs aren't all that tall, but they'll stop your progress cold: Your Viking may be able to slay giants, but they can't jump or climb... Read more.

notes.title: Tribes of Midgard: How to repair weapons and gear
notes.notes: Want to know how to repair weapons in Tribes of Midgard? You'll need to do it fairly often because weapons, gear, and tools become damaged pretty quickly during fights and resource gathering. The thing is, it's not immediately obvious how to do it, or even where to find the repair bench... Read more.

Hey Vikings,

Now, let’s chat a bit about how we’re going to support Tribes of Midgard long past launch. How does that work? We will keep the game fresh with seasonal updates that we call [b]Sagas[/b], and we’ve got an [b]early look[/b] at our content roadmap to share with you below.

[b]One quick note:[/b] while the below roadmap applies to both the story-driven Saga Mode and the endless Survival Mode, Saga Mode is where you'll discover the Saga Boss quest line and earn exclusive seasonal rewards.

[h3][b]With all that, let’s check the roadmap:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/40069c061894c3e9190277cff04710825c606710.png[/img]

More on the blog [url=https://blog.playstation.com/2021/07/08/tribes-of-midgard-post-launch-plans-revealed/]here![/url]

Season one is near - July 27th! As you can see there's more to be revealed, and we plan to have Mid-Season Updates, and new Saga Quests as the game evolves. This seasonal content will expand the world of Tribes of Midgard. 

Each Saga will be centered around a challenging Saga Boss – and the tools you’ll need to take them down. These Sagas will build on each other in that we won't remove previously released content. In the end, our vision is to create the ultimate Norse-themed sandbox where players can live their own mythology.

Thanks for being a part of this journey which has been long in the making - we hope to see you wielding your weapons in Midgard, soon! Finally, be sure [url=https://discord.com/invite/tribesofmidgard]to join our Discord[/url] for even more, and to hang out with our community.

The Norsfell Team 🗻

notes.title: Co-op Viking ARPG Tribes of Midgard has a refreshing take on boss fights
notes.notes: When you hear "10-player co-op Viking survival game" it's hard not to immediately think of Valheim. But Tribes of Midgard, launching July 27, isn't really anything like Valheim. It supports up to 10 players (solo mode is an option as well) but it's an action RPG with a big focus on base defense. Survival and crafting systems are present but incredibly streamlined, and its primary mode is session-based and only lasts a few hours... Read more.

notes.title: Get ready for the Battle, Come Join our Tribe!
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,

Long time no talk - we’re happy to be back with some updates! We have good news to share with you about development and the Midguardians program. Let’s dive right in. :)

A quick update on our team - we’ve been working from home for over a year now, but the game is coming along [b]at an amazing pace[/b]. We’ve been feeding our team snacks by mail ([url=https://twitter.com/norsfell/status/1389931678156697602]seriously, check it out[/url]) and our motivation’s never been stronger.

So get ready - the time to battle is on the horizon. The game is coming out in [b]2021 on PC, PS5 and PS4[/b], and we’ll have more information on a release date soon. And with the big moment coming up, we need your help to build the strongest community group of Vikings out there, to fight the great fight when release arrives - that’s where the Midguardians come in! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/80ae857496289320387627682a2a1b36273cda99.png[/img]

[b]What are the Midguardians?[/b]

The Midguardians are first and foremost a community group, a place to connect with others who are looking forward to and supporting Tribes of Midgard. It’s for anyone who wants to be more involved in our community. We’re up to over 1000 Midguardians now on our Discord (honestly, a proper Viking army).

The Midguardians are similar to other rewards programs, where you complete actions to earn rewards. These small actions really add up, and help give us the strength necessary to develop Tribes of Midgard.

[b]What’s the benefit of being a Midguardian?[/b]

The benefits include rewards such as:
[list]
[*] Being part of a growing community of Vikings
[*] Access to Private Testing phases
[*] Access to exclusive Discord channels
[*] Sneak peeks at new game content
[*] In-game cosmetics
[*] Real-life swag
[*] And more surprises!
[/list]
Besides that, you get to come hang out with an awesome and welcoming group of players!

[b]How does the system work?[/b]

Similar to other rewards programs, you’ll earn points for completing actions. We have a handy Discord bot who’s capable of tracking your progress, so you’ll always have an eye on what level you’re at and what rewards you earn.

[b]How to join the Midguardians?[/b]

Everything is free and accessible to everyone. However, we ask to apply via a form through our website in order to have you sign an NDA. Unlike our previous test phases, it won’t be possible to stream any private tests. We need your help during these technical tests, for feedback with which to keep improving the game.

[url=http://www.tribesofmidgard.com/midguardians/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/f2b7c3f4311e835e8e17a7800d44913636104fde.png[/img][/url]

[b]Will there be more Open Betas?[/b]

We know that you’ve been wanting to play (and that means a lot!), but at the moment as we develop the game, an Open Beta isn’t possible. The Midguardians are a way for us to offer a more [b]controlled technical test[/b], while also giving us the time to keep working on the game.

Questions? Just want to say hello? Come hang out in our Discord server!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/tribesofmidgard][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/e402806b91e524342beef9d1b849490c67fb8a64.png[/img]
[/url]
We’ll be continuing more frequent updates here (seriously, how did so much time pass? I blame the Goblins). And finally, to stay up to date on the game’s progress, make sure to follow us on our socials:

Twitter: https://twitter.com/tribesofmidgard
Instagram: https://instagram.com/tribesofmidgard
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/tribesofmidgard/

We can't thank you enough for the continued support these past months, it means the world to us. Midgard will be waiting for you, when the time comes.

See you soon,
The Norsfell Team 🗻

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - July 10/20
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,

Some different news today! Since February 2019, we've been sharing a Dev Update, every single week. 

After over [b]70 updates[/b], we realize that this probably isn't the best way to[b] "show"[/b] you what we're working on. Not going to lie, sometimes it looked more like a shopping list instead of exciting features. 

So, we want to bring you a more visual, impactful way to see new features. We're players too, so we want to bring something that's a bit more "wow", and save the features that we're not [i]quite[/i] ready to share yet, and hope they will surprise you. 🙂

This is why we've decided to [b]stop the Weekly Dev Updates[/b] as they are now, which don't exactly reflect what we're working on.

notes.title: Big News: Tribes of Midgard has a Publisher!
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,
 
We’re excited to announce today that...
 
[h3] [b]Norsfell and Gearbox Publishing have teamed up to bring Tribes of Midgard to PlayStation 5! [/b][/h3]


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T9REePDIKog

 
[b]Tribes of Midgard will be available in 2021! [/b]We can’t contain our excitement, and are so happy to share this news with you.
 
Nearly two years have passed since we first started working on the game — we’ve received so much feedback and support from all of you during that time, and have seen the game evolve before our eyes. This couldn’t have been possible [b]without such a supportive and enthusiastic community like you[/b], and for that, our thanks are immeasurable.
 
[b]What to Expect[/b]

 
We’re the same team of Vikings, and we’ll still be keeping things as usual around here! We’re just adding additional resources to ensure this game continues to match our vision of what it can become. Posts like our regular dev updates, sneak peeks at upcoming features, and all the love that we share as a community will still continue.
 
If you’re feeling the same excitement as us, feel free to share the trailer!
 
Lastly, from all of us here at Norsfell, thank you/Þakkr! 💙

notes.title: Introducing The Midguardians!
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings!

Today, we have some big news to share with you, about game test phases and the Midguardians. 

A year ago, we launched our first Closed Alpha, and had 250 Discord members. That was the first time you were able to try Tribes of Midgard (who remembers the flying trees)?

Today, after 3 Closed Alpha and 3 Open Betas, thousands of you are helping us spread Tribes of Midgard across all social networks. This support allows us to gain an incomparable strength helping us to develop Tribes of Midgard. Thank you again, because you really make a huge difference.

There is still a long way to go and we understand and share your excitement around Tribes of Midgard. We would like to be able to leave the gates open at all times, but being still in development, it is difficult for us to do so. 

It’s for this reason that we announced that our last Open Beta would be in December 2019. But today, we want to share with you what's coming!

[h1]Introducing: The Midguardians![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/80ae857496289320387627682a2a1b36273cda99.png[/img]

Next, are private testing phases, reserved for our most active members and framed in a brand new program: The Midguardians!

[b]What are the Midguardians?[/b]

The Midguardians as we know them today are going to be radically different. A Midguardian is a player who wants to get more involved in the Tribes of Midgard community.

Today, there are 620 Midguardians on our Discord, helping us share Tribes across social networks and getting involved in our Discord. So naturally, we want to reward them, because these small actions add up, and help give us the strength necessary to develop Tribes of MIdgard.

[b]What are the Rewards?[/b]

Rewards include access to private testing phases, and rewards such as in-game cosmetics, swag, and other surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/b99df13b925b1b1e54a01364eed4a71327fd152c.png[/img]

[b]How to collect these rewards?[/b]

We have implemented a Level and Points system to make the experience more visible and “fair” for everyone. By being active, you increase levels that allow you to access new rewards.

[b]How to join the Midguardians?[/b]

Everything is free and accessible to everyone! However, we ask to apply via a form in order to have you sign an NDA.
[url=https://www.tribesofmidgard.com/midguardians/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/852ff989876a79bb73a4ba12f3ac77bc333c4b41.png[/img][/url]

[b]Why an NDA?[/b]

Unlike our first 6 test phases, it will not be possible to stream or create content during these private tests, and you must sign an NDA to take part. We want to use these private tests for feedback with which to keep improving the game. 

[h1]What if I’m already a Midguardian?[/h1]
620 people in our Discord joined the first version of the Midguardians. Since it’s now necessary to apply and sign an NDA, we've renamed them, "Midguardians Volunteer". We invite you to apply to become a full Midguardian. It goes without saying that, given your pre-engagement, you will be more likely to be a full Midguardian. Right now, we cannot accept everyone, and plan to have 600 Midguardians at this time to give us time to put everything in place. 

[b]No more Closed Beta/Open Beta?[/b]

We know that we want to offer new testing phases to our community, but at the moment, as we develop the game it is not possible. The Midguardians are a way for us to offer private tests to you, while also allowing us the time to keep working on the game.


We’ll be available on Discord to be answering any and all of your questions, please join here!:

[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/tribesofmidgard][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/ee27962b6258b7875195c50855141c548f82b850.png[/img][/url]

We hope you’re excited for this as we are! Thank you for your support! ⚔️🙏

The Norsfell Team 🗻

notes.title: January Recap: New Features in the works!
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,

January has come and gone, and it's time for our monthly recap. Big things are happening! What exactly, you ask? We're here to let you know! 😄

While the game is currently closed, we want to keep you in the loop about all the features we're working on! We're moving full speed ahead on Tribes of Midgard - and can't wait to show you the next version of the game. 

[b]Here's a recap of some of the biggest things we're working on:[/b]

⚒️ Construction system: place walls, towers and ramps!
😈 A third Giant, whose form may surprise you
🏠 Revamping the Village layout
🔁 Preparing procedural generation for new mechanics
📝 Level Design of the Dark Elf Bastion
🔑 Modelling the Gates of the Dark Elf Bastion (which require a key to open)
🏃 Updating enemy movement so that they can run further in the world
⛺️ New Camps in the Land of Pools
☃️ Research on Hot/Cold Gauges
👕 New Armor set, shields, and weapons

Our third Giant's form is a [i]little[/i] different from anything you've seen so far! And with the addition of some different types of Camps (the ones that include doors and keys) there will be new points of interest to check out all over the world. 

We'll be sharing how everything is looking, starting February! Make sure to follow us on whichever platform you use most to catch it all 👇

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - January 29/20
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,

We are progressing on the work from the previous week but we are also starting some big changes in the world exploration. This includes creating some Camps (Elf Bastions) that will have Gates, that require a key to unlock. 

[b]This week we’re:[/b]

🏠 – Revamping the Village Layout Logic 
🌃 – Revamping the Procedural Generation Logic
👹 – Improving current Giant Attacks for all Giants
🌆 – Continuing Level Design of the Dark Elf Bastion
🔑 – Modelling in 3D the Gates of the Dark Elf Bastion
🌿 – Continuing on implementing the new Grass System
🏃 – Designing AI with new Movement Patterns & Behaviors
🏢 – Implementing Free Construction with Walls, Slopes and Grounds
🔨 – Fixing various issues for Controller, UI, Crashes, Modules & Materials
📖 – Researching various features for Hot/Cold Gauges, Events & Season Changes
🐍 – Texturing/Modeling in 3D the Lindworm Creature

What's a Lindworm? Glad you asked. It's a legendary, dragon-like, serpent-like monster with claws. It won't be flying around Midgard though, as it's wingless, but you can bet it's going to slither around the Land of Pools in the future. Adding more creatures to the world is part of continuing our the quest of making Midgard feel more alive. Here's some of its original concept art (we'll be showing its final form very soon)!: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/db6ec8dc9973e74d757d9ea0013542ec2c460fac.png[/img]

[b]Talking about exploration and environments, what kind of Biome would you like to see in the game later on?[/b] 

Tell us which one(s)! 👀

In case you haven't played yet, we currently have 5 Biomes:[list][*] Bright Forest (Forest)
[*] Glacier Peak (Snow)
[*] Ash Beach (Beach)
[*] Smoky Highlands (Desert)
[*] Land of Pools (Swamp)
[/list]
Catch you next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35480627/c7d2146e1dafe14d1807a36edaf71fd11e2a033c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update - January 22/20
notes.notes:
Hey Vikings,

Last week, we’d been talking about different changes that would affect the game experience and we're on a roll! 

Another aspect of the game that we're working on is making the world feel more "full"- this is one of our focuses this week along with new weapon spells. We've been working on new Camps to add to our swamp biome, the Land of Pools.

[b]This week, we’re:[/b]

🔪 – Designing the level of the Elf Bastion
🔑 – Modelling in 3D the Gate of the Elf Bastion
🌿 – Exploring new Grass system to create Props
🏃 – Updating AI to be able to chase Players further
🛂 – Preparing the opportunity to port the game in Consoles
⛺ – Continuing on finishing the Small Camp for the Land of Pools
📓 – Animating new Spells for new Weapons like the Baldur’s Revenge
🔨 – Fixing various issues for Passwords, Modules, Customization and Logging
📖 – Researching various features for Village Layout, Blessings and Hot/Cold Gauges

[b]Is there any weapon spell you wish to see in the game later on?[/b]

Let us know which ones! If you haven't played the game yet, our weapon spells are based around elemental attacks, so for example, a Dark skill would come from a Dark sword, and its color would be specific to the element (Dark = purple). When fighting, you'll also find opposite elements have better damage against each other, so if you're fighting our Fire Giant (Hàlogi) you'd definitely want to pick up an ice weapon.

Here's how the Dark Whirlwind looks for the Lindworm Sword:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/e4dcc92a9f7ca87a798d4ed87203529873dbe270.gif[/img]

And the Thunderstorm skill for Ymir's Eyelash sword...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/3cc2dc3891898d9a0014d020eba2b181ff94eaa7.gif[/img]

If you're curious and want to read more about all the weapons in-game and each of their skills, check out our Wiki, which is community-made and still expanding!:

https://tribesofmidgard.gamepedia.com/Weapons

See you next week!

notes.title: Play The Last Open Beta NOW, Dec 11th-15th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35462321/908e7db74ba2dc5ba61c30108297e11b4b3e91c5.gif[/img]

Hey Vikings! The time is here, and Midgard awaits! This will be our last Open Beta before we head to Early Access, so gather your Tribe and join in!
